jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Akutspital Pensum nach Vereinbarung für die Region Zumikon gesucht
jobs.description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Zumikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutspital.

### Ihr neuer Job als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Zumikon im Überblick

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Zumikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Zumikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch seine idyllische Lage mit Nähe zur Natur und zum Zürichsee. Die Gemeinde verfügt über eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung durch die S-Bahn, welche Sie schnell ins Zürich Stadtzentrum bringt. Als Arbeitsort ist Zumikon besonders attraktiv, da Sie hier ein perfektes Gleichgewicht zwischen ländlichem Charakter und urbaner Erreichbarkeit finden und zudem von einem gehobenen Umfeld mit stabiler Infrastruktur profitieren.

### Ihr Wirkungsfeld als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Zumikon

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Damit überzeugen Sie uns

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Zumikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
In der Region Zumikon besteht eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern HF/FH für Akutspitäler, da der demografische Wandel und die steigende Patientenzahl qualifiziertes Fachpersonal erfordern. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und flexiblen Pensumsmodellen, die eine optimale Work-Life-Balance ermöglichen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler dabei, schnell und unkompliziert die passende Stelle zu finden und den Einstieg in Ihr neues Arbeitsumfeld zu erleichtern.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Zumikon

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Zumikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Tipp: Laufend neue [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Zumikon wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

- Senden Sie uns darum noch heute Ihre Bewerbung als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Zumikon – wir begleiten Sie dabei persönlich.

jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie 80-100% für die Region Zurzach gesucht
jobs.description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Zurzach suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutpsychiatrie.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Zurzach

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutpsychiatrie

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Zurzach

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Zurzach liegt im nördlichen Aargau direkt am Rhein und besticht durch eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Mischung aus ländlichem Charme und wirtschaftlicher Dynamik, insbesondere durch den bekannten Kurort und diverse Gewerbeunternehmen. Mit ihrer Nähe zu Deutschland und der guten Infrastruktur profitieren Sie von kurzen Pendelwegen und einer stabilen lokalen Wirtschaft.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Zurzach

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutpsychiatrie

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Zurzach verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern in der Akutpsychiatrie ist in der Region Zurzach anhaltend hoch, da etablierte Fachkliniken kontinuierlich qualifiziertes Personal suchen. Mit Ihrem HF- oder FH-Abschluss profitieren Sie von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können von attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen ausgehen. iPersonal als spezialisierter Vermittler kennt die regionalen Arbeitgeber bestens und verkürzt durch maßgeschneiderte Matching-Prozesse den Weg zu Ihrer idealen Stelle erheblich. Damit sparen Sie Zeit und erhalten professionelle Unterstützung bei der Jobsuche in diesem gefragten Fachbereich.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Zurzach

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Zurzach

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Tipp: Laufend neue [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie auf med-ipersonal.ch – täglich aktualisiert.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Zurzach wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.
- Senden Sie uns darum noch heute Ihre Bewerbung als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Zurzach – wir begleiten Sie dabei persönlich.

**Per E-Mail:** nk@med-ipersonal.ch

jobs.description:
Fachfrau/Fachmann Gesundheit EFZ 80-100% in Vitznau gesucht – Deine Expertise, unsere Wertschätzung

Vitznau liegt am Vierwaldstättersee im Kanton Luzern und besticht durch seine malerische Lage zwischen See und Alpen. Die Gemeinde ist gut mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erreichbar und verfügt über eine direkte Bahnanbindung. Die Region bietet Ihnen als Arbeitsort ein ausgezeichnetes Gleichgewicht zwischen beruflichen Chancen, hoher Lebensqualität und direkter Nähe zur Natur, was Sie besonders für Remote-Arbeit oder in touristischen Branchen reizt.

**Einsatzort:** Vitznau und Umgebung
**Einsatzbeginn:** Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Du liebst es, Menschen professionell zu betreuen und möchtest in einem Umfeld arbeiten, in dem deine Arbeit geschätzt wird? Als Fachfrau/Fachmann Gesundheit EFZ bist du eine unverzichtbare Stütze im Gesundheitswesen. Du trägst täglich dazu bei, dass Patientinnen und Patienten bestmöglich versorgt werden, sei es in der Langzeitpflege, im Spital oder in der Spitex. Deine Arbeit macht den Unterschied – Tag für Tag.

Unser Personalbüro für Pflege in Vitznau vermittelt qualifizierte Fachkräfte an renommierte Institutionen. Wir bieten dir offene Stellen für Pflege in Vitznau, die perfekt zu deinen Fähigkeiten und Bedürfnissen passen.

**Deine Aufgaben – Mehr als ein Job, eine Berufung**

- Individuelle Pflege und Betreuung von Patientinnen und Patienten im stationären oder ambulanten Bereich

- Unterstützung bei der Grundpflege sowie Verabreichung von Medikamenten nach ärztlicher Anweisung

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Pflegefachpersonen und Ärztinnen sowie interdisziplinären Teams

- Erkennung von Veränderungen im Zustand der Patientinnen und Patienten sowie Weiterleitung relevanter Informationen

- Dokumentation von pflegerischen Maßnahmen und Beachtung von Qualitätsstandards

- Empathischer Umgang mit Patientinnen und Angehörigen, um eine vertrauensvolle Atmosphäre zu schaffen

**Dein Profil – Deine Stärken bringen uns weiter**

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachfrau/Fachmann Gesundheit EFZ

- Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen in der Pflege, aber auch Berufseinsteiger sind willkommen

- Zuverlässigkeit, Teamgeist und Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen

- Verantwortungsbewusstes und selbstständiges Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

**Unser Angebot – Weil du es verdienst**

- Vielfältige offene Stellen für Pflege in Vitznau, angepasst an deine individuellen Wünsche

- Temporärstellen für Pflege in Vitznau, falls du Flexibilität bevorzugst

- Persönliche Karriereberatung und individuelle Unterstützung bei der Jobsuche

- Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur fachlichen Entwicklung in spezialisierten Pflegebereichen

- Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen in modernen Einrichtungen mit wertschätzender Arbeitsatmosphäre

jobs.title: Föreståndare
jobs.description:
Föreståndare till Vikingens vårdboende

Vikingens vårdboende söker en engagerad och trygg föreståndare som vill vara med och leda och utveckla vår verksamhet.

Vikingens vårdboende är en del av Omsorgshuset, vilket innebär att du inte står ensam i ditt uppdrag. Du blir en del av en organisation där vi arbetar tillsammans, stöttar varandra och delar erfarenheter och kompetens.

Som föreståndare är du direkt underställd VD, vilket ger korta och tydliga beslutsvägar. Du får därmed nära till stöd och möjlighet att snabbt fatta beslut och driva verksamheten framåt.

Om tjänsten

Som föreståndare ansvarar du för att leda, samordna och utveckla verksamheten. Du arbetar nära medarbetare, boende och närstående och säkerställer att verksamheten bedrivs med god kvalitet, tydlighet och respekt.

I rollen ingår bland annat att:

    leda och stötta medarbetarna i det dagliga arbetet
    ansvara för verksamhetens kvalitet och utveckling
    arbeta strukturerat med rutiner, dokumentation och uppföljning
    skapa en trygg och professionell miljö för våra boende
    ha kontakt och samverka med närstående, myndigheter och andra aktörer
    arbeta med personalfrågor, planering och verksamhetsutveckling
    säkerställa att verksamheten följer gällande lagar, riktlinjer och föreskrifter.

Vi söker dig som

Vi ser gärna att du är socionom eller har annan relevant högskoleutbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.

Du har erfarenhet av arbete inom vård och omsorg, socialt arbete eller liknande verksamhet. Erfarenhet av arbetsledning eller chefsansvar är meriterande.

Som person är du:

    trygg och tydlig i ditt ledarskap
    ansvarstagande och strukturerad
    lyhörd och respektfull i mötet med människor
    lösningsorienterad och prestigelös
    engagerad i kvalitets- och utvecklingsarbete.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och påverka och utveckla Vikingens vårdboende. Du blir en del av Omsorgshuset, där du har kollegor och stöd omkring dig samtidigt som du har ett tydligt mandat och nära kontakt med VD.

Du får ett viktigt och ansvarsfullt uppdrag där ditt ledarskap har direkt betydelse för både våra boende och våra medarbetare.

Välkommen till en organisation med korta beslutsvägar, nära ledarskap och stort engagemang för våra boende!

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
About AIWI

AIWI is an independent non-profit that exists to ensure that insiders at frontier AI companies can speak up safely and effectively when they see something that should be addressed. We do this by integrating the ecosystem of lawyers, AI researchers, AI advocacy organizations, journalists, regulators, and policymakers who can act on what they learn.

Tasks

About the role

You will own all of AIWI's technology: architecture, implementation, deployment, security, and maintenance. Delivery will be hands-on and you will manage a budget for executing items defined on your roadmap. You will work closely with the founders, Head of Security, and translate requirements from our operations, research, and advocacy teams into working systems. The work is demanding, sensitive, and consequential; conviction in our mission is essential.

Areas of Ownership

  1. Internal tooling. We operate in a highly sensitive environment. Many commercial SaaS products, and hosted AI models in particular, do not meet our security and data sovereignty requirements. You will build and operate our self-hosted, primarily OSS stack end to end: A secure CRM tailored to our needs, state-of-the-art self-hosted AI models and agent systems integrated into knowledge management, call recording, communication tooling, other OSS software we self host, and in-house development of news tracking solutions. If you are excited about designing architecture that allows air-gapping and decentralized access, this role is for you.
  2. External-facing technology. You take offerings from prototype to production end-to-end: Zero-knowledge proof solutions for anonymous coordination, interactive scenario simulators, or automated legislation trackers. Projects can span months or require rapid 3-day delivery. You will also oversee the tech-side of our website. Your solutions will directly drive the impact and safety of AI whistleblowers.

This means you will frequently handle multiple projects simultaneously. You will be the first non-volunteer engineer working on AIWI dedicated technology. Across all areas, security is foundational. You will work closely here with our Head of Security.

Given nature of role, onsite London preferred; remote considered

Requirements

  • Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI safety and whistleblower protection
  • 10 years in software engineering with DevOps experience in fast-moving settings
  • Excellent proficiency across systems-, backend- and web-development;
  • proficiency with systems languages (Rust, Go, C, C++ etc.) required
  • experience with JS/TS, HTML, CSS, web frameworks required
  • Python for AI and Data pipelines required
  • Excellent project management abilities and communication skills especially towards non-technical colleagues
  • Strong grasp of CI/CD, security hardening, cloud and self-hosted infrastructure
  • IAC experience (Ansible, OpenTofu, etc.) required
  • Experience deploying and integrating existing AI models and tooling (self-hosted open-weight models, agent frameworks, APIs where appropriate) — this is systems integration, not ML research or model training
  • Ability to rapidly execute and ability to distinguish between levels of QA and security required for different projects
  • Rigorous approach to threat modeling and operational security. You do not have to be a security expert as you will be working with our Head of Security -- but should bring a strong mindset and strong foundational knowledge

Benefits

What we offer

  • Work as part of an ambitious team committed to a high leverage intervention: A single whistleblower disclosure can move the world if handled well. We get up every morning to make it go well.
  • Work on a vast breadth of technological challenges and varying project sizes
  • Ownership and responsibility from day 1
  • Chance to define your personal career development
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
  • Coaching by AIWI board member and serial entrepreneur/ CTO as well as close collaboration with an extremely experienced Head of Security.

Compensation

  • Salary: £70,000-£90,000 per annum
  • Benefits (Pension, Gym benefit, L&D fund, co-working space, & occasional travel for company-wide offsites)
  • Leave
  • Flexible scheduling; occasional out-of-hours work required

Referral programme

We provide a reward of £4,000 for successful referrals upon completion of a 6-month employment period. Allocation will occur based on a a successful applicant's attribution in the case of multiple referrers.

jobs.description:
Ben jij een System Engineer die graag verder bouwt aan stabiele IT-omgevingen én aan je eigen toekomst? In deze rol krijg je technische autonomie, impact bij klanten en ruimte om te groeien via opleidingen en certificeringen. Je versterkt het team in een structurele functie met langdurige samenwerking, waar stabiliteit centraal staat en een vast contract bespreekbaar is.

Zo ziet je werkdag eruit
Als System Engineer werk je zowel on-site bij klanten als remote aan betrouwbare en toekomstgerichte IT-omgevingen. Je analyseert bestaande systemen, denkt mee over verbeteringen en vertaalt technische noden naar concrete oplossingen.

  • Je start bijvoorbeeld met het evalueren van een IT-infrastructuur bij een klant. Waar kan het efficiënter? Welke optimalisaties zijn mogelijk binnen cloud, security of netwerkbeheer? Samen met de technische verantwoordelijke stel je verbeteringen voor die het systeem stabieler en performanter maken.
  • Daarna ga je praktisch aan de slag: je installeert en configureert nieuwe systemen, integreert oplossingen in bestaande infrastructuren en zorgt ervoor dat alles veilig en efficiënt blijft draaien.
  • Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met collega’s, eindgebruikers en leveranciers. Problemen detecteer je vaak al voordat ze impact hebben. Als IT specialist / system engineer denk je proactief mee en zorg je voor duurzame oplossingen.

Geen dag is identiek: de ene dag werk je aan serverbeheer of cloudoplossingen, de andere dag optimaliseer je een infrastructuur of ondersteun je een klant bij een technische uitdaging.

Belangrijk: dit is een structurele functie binnen een stabiele organisatie, met duidelijke intentie tot een langdurige samenwerking en een vast contract.

Je hoeft niet alles al te kennen, maar je beschikt wel over een stevige basis en het vertrouwen om zelfstandig technische uitdagingen aan te pakken.

  • Studieachtergrond: je behaalde een diploma in IT, systeem- en netwerkbeheer, informatica of een gelijkaardige richting. Relevante ervaring kan dit ook compenseren.
  • Ervaring: je hebt al enkele jaren gewerkt als System Engineer, IT Support Engineer, System Administrator of in een gelijkaardige rol. Daardoor ben je snel inzetbaar.
  • Technische kennis: je hebt een goede basis in Windows Server, netwerken, virtualisatie en cloudomgevingen. Ervaring met Microsoft 365, Azure, security of infrastructuurbeheer is een sterke troef.
  • Maturiteit: je communiceert professioneel met klanten en collega’s en kan technische oplossingen helder uitleggen.
  • Zelfstandigheid: je kan prioriteiten stellen, problemen analyseren en oplossingen uitwerken zonder dat iemand elke stap moet sturen.
  • Leergierigheid: technologie evolueert snel en jij vindt het net interessant om je kennis te blijven verdiepen via opleidingen en certificeringen.

jobs.title: [Contract] Language Training Specialist - Japanese
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an experienced Localization Project Manager — Japan Training Quality to support localization for Customer Education, helping ensure Notion training content feels accurate, clear, culturally relevant, and ready to use for learners across the globe.

You’ll work at the intersection of localization quality, training implementation, and program management, collaborating with Localization, Partner Enablement, Customer Education, vendors, and language specialists. You’ll help turn translation feedback, learner experience issues, and regional quality needs into practical improvements across training content, quizzes, LMS setup, and repeatable localization workflows.

The ideal candidate combines native-level Japanese language expertise with a deep understanding of what effective education looks like in the Japanese market.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own and apply Japanese localization QA standards across training content, including checking for accuracy, clarity, tone, terminology, and cultural nuance

 - Support development of glossaries, style guides, QA checklists, review processes, and localization assets

 - Become a go-to partner for translation questions related to Notion-specific concepts, product terminology, and training context

 - Support QA of technical implementation in eLearning authoring tools and LMS environments (course files, quizzes, answer selections)

 - Coordinate across Customer Education, Partner Enablement, Localization, and vendors to align on priorities, timelines, translation progress, and quality expectations

 - Identify workflow risks and recommend improvements that improve translation quality and reduce time-to-launch

 - Document repeatable processes that make training and help center localization easier to manage over time




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong understanding of localization workflows, including vendor collaboration, review cycles, glossaries, style guides, QA rubrics, and linguistic QA

 - Experience with Japanese localization QA, ideally for SaaS, technical training, customer education, or partner enablement content

 - Ability to review translated content for quality, clarity, terminology accuracy, cultural nuance, and learner comprehension

 - Familiarity with eLearning or LMS tools; experience with platforms like Skilljar or Parta authoring tools is a plus

 - Comfort working with technical or product-specific terminology that may not translate directly

 - Strong attention to detail, especially in learner-facing content, quizzes, course setup, formatting, and implementation QA

 - Strong project management skills and ability to bring structure into ambiguous areas




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

We want all of our learners should feel like Notion training content was made for them — not simply translated for them. High-quality localization has a direct impact on learner trust, comprehension, launch readiness, and regional enablement outcomes.

About the role:

We're looking for someone who can build Zilch's external partnership strategy from the ground up, not someone who manages a partner roster they've inherited, and not someone who only closes deals other people have framed up.

You'll work out who Zilch should be aligned with and why, build the commercial logic for that, and then see it through: proposals, business cases, and working with Product, Finance and Compliance to actually bring a partnership to life. You won't be expected to arrive with a black book of contacts ready to close, we can teach deal mechanics. What we can't teach is the judgement to spot the right partnership and the rigour to structure it properly.

You'll operate across two parallel tracks: accelerating distribution of Zilch's existing proposition through embedded, high-value partner relationships, and building new revenue streams by licensing Zilch's core capabilities into new products, models and markets. You'll work directly with the VP of Partnerships, with high visibility into the C-suite.

Strategy and market thesis

  • Mapping the market: financial services, fintech, payments infrastructure, retail, platforms and beyond to identify which partnership categories genuinely fit Zilch's brand and commercial position, using your own judgement rather than a provided list

Proposal development and deal structuring

  • Building commercial proposals and business cases from scratch — defining the model, sizing the opportunity, and making the argument internally and externally

Relationship building and execution

  • Originating relationships at senior and C-suite level, building credibility as a serious commercial counterpart

  • Confidence operating at C-suite and senior stakeholder level, both internally and externally

jobs.description:
About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

The opportunity

Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for a Senior Data Scientist to help build the next generation of generative and predictive models of cellular behaviour, with a focus on single cell multi-omics. Your work will be central to our mission to understand and control cellular decision-making, enabling novel therapeutic strategies grounded in generative models.

You'll be joining a team with access to cutting-edge multiomic and interventional datasets, advanced computational infrastructure, and deep interdisciplinary expertise, and a culture that embraces modern ML tooling, including agentic workflows, to accelerate research iteration. You will contribute advanced data analysis and domain expertise to challenge ML models that aim to predict and explain cellular decision-making in disease.

Day to day, you will

  • Process and QC paired single-cell RNA-seq and scATAC-seq at scale from thousands of perturbations across diverse cell types and biological contexts.

  • Develop and maintain Nextflow pipelines compatible with custom combinatorial indexing chemistries and including methods such as STARsolo, Alevin-fry, Chromap, and SnapATAC2.

  • Integrate scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq with extracellular proteomics and high-content imaging to build multimodal training datasets.

  • Manage data in memory-efficient formats (e.g. Zarr) for GPU-accelerated processing and model training at scale.

  • Partner closely with wet lab scientists from screen and cohort design through to interpretation, so experiments are analytically tractable and pipelines maximise data value.

  • Contribute to the evaluation framework that determines whether ML models capture meaningful biology: design metrics, held-out benchmarks, and biological sanity checks.

  • Collaborate closely with ML modellers to develop model architectures.

  • Present findings and methodologies to internal stakeholders and contribute to publications.

Professionally, you will have

  • A PhD (or equivalent industry experience) in computational biology, bioinformatics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Deep hands-on experience processing and analysing large-scale single-cell multiomics data, ideally including paired RNA + ATAC (10x Multiome or equivalent).

  • Proficiency with single-cell analysis toolkits (e.g. scverse ecosystem) and workflow management frameworks (Nextflow, Snakemake).

  • Experience with arrayed CRISPR perturbation screen data, including well-level perturbation assignment via sample hashing, perturbation-specific QC (e.g. MOI estimation), and single-cell effect quantification.

  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with high-performance computing environments.

  • Strong communication skills to bridge experimental and ML teams across a fast-moving programme

    Bonus Experience:

  • Experience integrating multiple data modalities (transcriptomics, chromatin accessibility, imaging and proteomics) for joint analysis.

  • Exposure to foundation model development or perturbation prediction models.

  • A background in statistical modelling and algorithm development.

  • Experience working in interdisciplinary teams.

Personally, you

  • Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

  • Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

  • Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

  • Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

  • Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

 

Working Style & Culture at Relation

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting!

About Relation

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

 

The opportunity

We are seeking an exceptional Machine Learning Scientist who combines strong ML fundamentals with a deep understanding of biological data, to help build the next generation of generative and predictive models of cellular behaviour. Your work will be central to our mission to understand and control cellular decision-making, enabling novel therapeutic strategies grounded in generative models.

You'll be joining a team with access to cutting-edge multiomic and interventional datasets, advanced computational infrastructure, and deep interdisciplinary expertise. We embrace modern ML tooling, including agentic workflows, to accelerate the pace of research iteration. This is an opportunity to push the boundaries of what generative modelling can achieve in complex, high-dimensional, and noisy real-world systems, and to see your work tested directly in experimental biology.

 

Day to day, you will

  • Design and implement generative modelling approaches that learn intervention effects from diverse biological data, including single-cell perturbation experiments.

  • Develop models that go beyond correlation, focusing on generalisation, counterfactual prediction, and experimental design.

  • Collaborate with experimental teams to design and validate computational hypotheses via iterative strategies that identify the highest-signal next experiment.

  • Evaluate models not just for fit, but for causal coherence, mechanistic fidelity, and utility in guiding real-world interventions.

  • Communicate findings clearly to colleagues and stakeholders from different disciplines.

 

Professionally, you will have

  • Excellence in Python and familiarity with scalable ML tooling and high-performance computing.

  • Strong engineering practice: confidence implementing models from scratch, comfortable with distributed training, profiling, and performance optimisation.

  • Demonstrable experience training models at scale, meaningfully scaling architectures or training schemes.

  • Comfort working with messy, noisy, real-world scientific data.

Bonus experience:

  • High-impact publications at the intersection of ML and biology.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions, Senior Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

Enterprise Solutions Manager, Managed by Industrious

About Managed by Industrious

For the last decade, companies with real workplace needs have solved them the hard way: building an internal real estate team, running a self-delivery project with a dozen different vendors, and hoping it all comes together on time. Managed by Industrious exists to break that model. We combine the operational expertise we've built running premium flexible workspace at scale with tailored, single-tenant solutions, so landlords and enterprise clients get a fully outsourced, hospitality-driven workplace, without the internal headcount or the fragmented delivery chain. It's our newest product line, and one of the fastest growing parts of the business.

The Opportunity

We're at the point where the model is proven and the demand is real, but the playbook is still being written. This role sits right at the center of that build. You'll take opportunities from a client's first conversation with us through to a signed deal and a live, operating space, working closely with the GM of Enterprise Solutions and a small, senior, fast-moving team. You won't be slotting into a fully formed process. You'll be helping define what that process becomes as the business scales across Europe.


Why Industrious

We've spent the last decade becoming the highest quality provider of flexible workspace in the market. Managed by Industrious is us taking that same operational rigor and hospitality standard and applying it to a completely different kind of client relationship, one where you're building a bespoke, single-tenant solution rather than selling into an existing space. It's early enough that you'll genuinely shape how this product line operates in Europe, and established enough that you're doing it with the backing, brand, and delivery capability of a company that's already proven this model works.

What Might Your Day Look Like

A client reaches out needing a dedicated space for a growing team, say 150 people, in a European city where we don't yet have a foothold for them. You get on the phone to understand what they're actually solving for: who's working there, what the culture needs to feel like, what's non-negotiable and what's flexible. You bring our design team in as a thought partner and land on a brief. From there you're in the market, working with brokerage channels to shortlist two or three sites that could work, and touring the client through them alongside you.

Once you've got a favorite or two, you're building pricing, which means understanding the landlord's lease terms on one side and our own design, build, and operating costs on the other, and pulling all of it into a proposal that's honest about what it will take to deliver. If the client is in, you're moving toward signing high level commercial terms with them and with the landlord at close to the same time, then spending the following weeks getting both to a final agreement.

The moment ink is dry, you're handing a clean, well-briefed project to design and construction, and making sure everything you promised the client is something the business can actually deliver, on time and on budget.

What You Will Own

  • You will manage the full lifecycle of a Managed by Industrious deal, from the first client conversation through to a live, operating space.

  • You will translate what a client says they need into a workable, costed real estate and design solution, working closely with our design team to get there.

  • You will lead landlord and broker relationships on every deal, negotiating lease terms that protect us and set the project up to succeed.

  • You will build the commercial model and client-facing proposal for each opportunity, pulling together lease costs, build costs, and operating costs into a single coherent picture.

  • You will run point on the transaction itself, from high level commercial terms through to final signed agreements with both the client and the landlord.

  • You will hand projects to our design and construction teams with everything they need to deliver on what was promised, and stay close enough through delivery that nothing gets lost in the handoff.

  • You will help build our own playbook as you go, documenting what works so the next deal moves faster than the last one.

  • You will generate your own opportunities when the pipeline calls for it. This isn't a role where you only work what's handed to you.

You Will Love This Role If

  • You get real energy from being the person who makes a complex deal actually happen, not just one piece of it.

  • You're comfortable holding two sides of a negotiation at once, a client who needs to be won over and a landlord who needs to be managed, and you don't lose the thread of either.

  • You'd rather help build a process than inherit a finished one, and you're not precious about the fact that things will change again next month.

  • You want to be trusted with real accountability early, and you're motivated by seeing a project through from a first phone call to a space full of people.

  • You're genuinely energized by the idea that you're building something inside a much larger, established company, without giving up the pace or ownership of a smaller one.

This Role Is Probably Not For You If

  • You want a role with a fixed, well worn process to execute against. This one is still being written, and you'll be one of the people writing it.

  • You'd rather stay on one side of a deal. This role asks you to be genuinely fluent on both the client side and the real estate side, not just conversant in one.

  • Ambiguity slows you down rather than something you push through. Our team is small and things move fast, so you'll often be figuring it out as you go.

  • You're looking for a role where business development isn't part of the job. When the pipeline needs it, you'll be picking up the phone yourself.

What We Are Looking For

  • A track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder deals or projects through to completion, ideally where you were the person holding the whole thing together rather than one workstream within it.

  • Strong client-facing instincts. You can sit across from a senior stakeholder, understand what they actually need underneath what they're asking for, and turn that into a solution they trust.

  • Comfort working both sides of a transaction. Experience with landlords, brokers, or portfolio-side real estate work is a strong plus, alongside client or account-facing experience.

  • Someone who's excited by the idea of building a new business line inside an established, high quality company, and who wants the accountability that comes with that.

Compensation
We offer a competitive base salary, depending on experience, skills, and role alignment in addition to eligibility for an annual bonus and participation in our long-term incentive program. But compensation is only part of the story.

At Industrious, we believe a good workplace supports the whole person. Not just the work they do. Our benefits are designed to give people the stability, flexibility, and room to grow that make a career sustainable.




Our Benefits May Include:

  • Heavily subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans to support you and your family

  • Flexible paid time off, to maintain balance

  • Paid parental leave to help you welcome a new child and focus on what matters most

  • Annual professional development grants so you can keep learning and growing

  • 401(k) retirement savings program to support long-term financial wellbeing

  • Wellness initiatives and additional employee support programs

  • Specific benefits may vary by role, location, and eligibility requirements

Equal Employment Opportunity: Industrious is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Als Shiftmanager zal jij instaan voor het goede verloop van een shift op elk mogelijk vlak. Je kan ervan op aan dat wij je via opleidingen klaarstomen in no time!

  • Je gaat van bij de start aan de slag in de keuken om alles te leren over de operationele werking van het restaurant:

    • het correct opstarten en instellen van alle apparatuur,
    • het controleren en aanvullen van de voorraden,
    • het controleren van de leveringen,
    • het klaarzetten van de benodigdheden voor de shift,…
  • Ook in de lobby word je meteen ingezet om te leren hoe best-in-class hospitality eruit ziet om klanten een geluksmomentje te bezorgen bij elk bezoek.

Uiteraard werk je tijdens jouw shiften mee aan alle mogelijke werkposten.
Geen enkele werkpost in de keuken of zaal heeft dus nog geheimen voor jou!

  • Je zorgt dat alle teamleden op de juiste werkpost staan en geeft operationele instructies waar nodig.
  • Je helpt er ook voor te zorgen dat alle servicetijden en kwaliteits- en hygiënenormen gerespecteerd worden.
  • Tegelijkertijd zorg je ervoor dat alle medewerkers er alles aan doen om iedere klant een topervaring te geven.
  • Na de shiften zorg je ervoor dat alle werkposten er weer spik en span uitzien.

Werken bij onze klant betekent Feel Good Moments voor jou, je collega’s en de klanten!

Om te kunnen uitblinken in deze rol, zien we jou liefst met:

  • Een eerste relevante ervaring is zeker mooi meegenomen, maar is geen must;
  • Een zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands en een goed begrip van het Frans;
  • Aangeboren People Management skills en een sterke voorkeur voor teamwork;
  • Bijzondere aandacht voor klanttevredenheid;

  • Een hoge werklust zonder bezwaar tegen weekend- en avondwerk;

jobs.title: Vertegenwoordiger B2B - Limburg
jobs.description:
Konvert Construct zoekt naar een Vertegenwoordiger B2B voor een vooraanstaande speler in de Belgische markt voor groene energie.
Onze klant staat bekend om zijn ingenieursbenadering en streven naar de hoogste kwaliteitsnormen in elk project. Als vertegenwoordiger B2B speel je een belangrijke rol in het verder ontwikkelen van hun groei in zowel de laadinfrastructuur als de zonnepaneleninstallatie, en bied je klanten de best mogelijke ondersteuning.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Uitbreiden van laadinfrastructuur: Je speelt een actieve rol in de groei van het netwerk door de installatie en integratie van nieuwe laadpunten onder ons beheer.
  • Betalingsmogelijkheden verbeteren: Je werkt aan het uitbreiden van de betalingsopties, inclusief laadpassen, om klanten meer flexibiliteit en gemak te bieden.
  • Relatiebeheer met laadpalen-eigenaars: Je neemt proactief contact op met eigenaars van laadpalen en biedt hen aan om hun laadpunten te beheren en aan te sturen, ook in het geval van overname van laadpalen van andere fabrikanten of operators.
  • Samenwerken met e-Mobility Service Providers (MSP’s): Je bouwt sterke relaties op met MSP’s en sluit contracten af om een breed scala aan laadpassen te ondersteunen op de laadinfrastructuur.
  • Contractmanagement betaalsystemen: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het afsluiten van contracten met leveranciers en partners voor verschillende betaalsystemen.
  • Klantenbegeleiding: Je begeleidt klanten bij het administratief en contractueel opzetten van betaalsystemen op hun laadpalen, zodat deze efficiënt en probleemloos functioneren.
  • Zonnepaneleninstallaties: Je speelt een actieve rol in het aanbieden en installeren van zonnepanelen, inclusief het beantwoorden van technische vragen van klanten over de werking van de systemen.
  • Technische kennis verdiepen: Je bent bereid om je verder te verdiepen in de technische aspecten van zonnepaneleninstallaties en laadinfra, zodat je klanten deskundig kunt adviseren en ondersteunen.
  • Klantenondersteuning: Je beantwoordt klantvragen en biedt gedetailleerde informatie over de installatie en het onderhoud van zonnepanelen en laadpalen.
  • Teamspirit: Je werkt nauw samen met een enthousiast en gedreven team om gezamenlijk doelen te bereiken.

Met deze verantwoordelijkheden draag je bij aan een innovatieve en klantgerichte aanpak binnen het domein van elektrische mobiliteit en hernieuwbare energie.

  • Je bent een praktische aanpakker met een hands-on mentaliteit.
  • Je bouwt graag duurzame relaties op met klanten, leveranciers en andere stakeholders.
  • Je hebt minimum 5 jaar ervaring in een B2B functie.
  • Je beschikt over een bachelor diploma.
  • Zelfstandig werken gaat je goed af, en je werkt steeds nauwkeurig en gestructureerd.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels; kennis van Frans en/of Duits is een mooie extra troef.
  • Je bent bereid om je te verdiepen in de technische aspecten van zonnepanelen en laadinfrastructuur.

jobs.title: Toimialajohtaja HUS Diagnostiikkakeskus Kemian ja mikrobiologian tulosyksikköön
jobs.description:
Haemme nyt HUS Diagnostiikkakeskukseen kemian ja mikrobiologian (KeMik) tulosyksikön toimialajohtajaa.

HUS Diagnostiikkakeskus on Suomen johtava kliinisten laboratorio- ja kuvantamispalvelujen tuottaja. Pääasiallinen toiminta-alueemme on HUS-yhtymän erikoissairaanhoito ja HUSiin kuuluvien hyvinvointialueiden perusterveydenhuolto. Vastaamme myös Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen ja Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialueen laboratorio- ja kuvantamistoiminnasta. Toimimme kahdeksalla lääketieteen erikoisalalla.

HUS Diagnostiikkakeskus vastaa valtakunnallisesti useista erityisosaamista ja -tekniikkaa vaativista diagnostisista tutkimuksista sekä yliopistolliselle sairaalalle kuuluvasta tutkimuksesta ja opetuksesta. HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksessa työskentelee noin 3400 laboratorio- ja kuvantamisalan asiantuntijaa yli 150 toimipisteessä.

KeMik-tulosyksikön kaksi vastuualuetta ovat kliininen kemia ja hematologia sekä kliininen mikrobiologia, joissa toimii yhteensä noin 850 monialaista terveydenhuollon ammattilaista.

Toimialajohtaja vastaa tulosyksikön toiminnasta ja taloudesta sekä siihen kuuluvien erikoisalojen kehittämisestä ja koordinoinnista koko HUS-alueella. Vastuu kattaa myös perusterveydenhuollolle tarjottavat palvelut.

Haemme määrätietoista ja yhteistyötaitoista johtajaa, jolla on osoitettu vahva kokemus ja näyttöä menestyksekkäästä toimialan toimintayksiköiden johtamisesta, talouden hallinnasta ja toiminnan kehittämisestä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kykyä johtaa muutoksia, hyviä neuvottelutaitoja sekä innovatiivista otetta toiminnan uudistamiseen. Arvostamme asiakaslähtöistä toimintatapaa ja kokemusta asiakkuuksien hallinnasta.

Virkaan tai tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä voidaan tehdä hakijan suostumuksella henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (Turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014). Turvallisuusselvitysmenettelystä ja selvityksen kohteen oikeuksista löytyy tarkempia tietoja osoitteessawww.supo.fi/turvallisuusselvitykset.

Toimialajohtajan esihenkilönä toimii Diagnostiikkakeskuksen tulosaluejohtaja.

Aloitus tehtävässä on 1.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan

jobs.description:
Haluatko olla mukana tekemässä merkityksellistä työtä opiskelijoiden parhaaksi yhdessä moniammatillisen supertiimin kanssa?

Haemme Vatsakeskukseen osaavaa ja kehittämisestä innostunutta hoitotyön kliinistä opettajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

HUSin vatsakeskuksessa hoidetaan vatsan alueen, verisuonten, virtsa- ja sukuelinten sekä umpirauhasten ja aineenvaihdunnan sairauksia. Erikoisalaamme ovat urologia, endokrinologia ja endokriininen kirurgia, elinsiirto- ja maksakirurgia, nefrologia, gastroenterologia, vatsaelinkirurgia sekä verisuonikirurgia sekä dialyysitoiminta. Olemme sitoutuneet jatkuvaan laadun parantamiseen, jota tukee ISO 9001 -laatujärjestelmä. Yksikkömme toimivat Meilahden torni- ja kolmiosairaalassa sekä siltasairaalassa, kirurgisessa sairaalassa, puistosairaalassa sekä Jorvin, Peijaksen,Lohjan, Hyvinkään, Porvoon ja Raaseporin sairaaloissa.

Kliinisen opettajan työnkuva ja keskeiset tehtävät

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - m/f/d
jobs.description:
Where Europe's enterprises adopt AI

Langdock is the AI platform used by more than 10,000 companies to give employees secure access to the leading AI models, to build and share agents and to automate repetitive workflows. We have grown past $40M ARR while remaining a small team, and we care deeply about operating efficiently across the entire company.

For many enterprises, Langdock is becoming the place where most of the net-new work is produced. As people and agents create more documents, analyses, decisions, and automations inside AI interfaces, the context and data behind that work accumulate within Langdock. This gives us the opportunity to earn a larger role in their technology stack by building a platform they choose to rely on.

Our ambition is to build that platform for European enterprises while preserving their control over data, model providers, and deployment environments. We have made meaningful progress at the application layer, but much of the foundation beneath it still needs to be built.

You can watch the Meet the engineering team video to get a feeling for how we work.

The role

Platform Engineers own the shared capabilities that Langdock's products are built on. They treat these capabilities as internal products: defining the interfaces other teams build against and remaining accountable for their reliability, evolution, and operation over time.

The work is to turn complex capabilities such as model access, agent execution, authorization, queues, integrations, document processing, and sandboxed compute into stable, reusable building blocks. Each capability needs a clear contract and must be able to evolve without forcing coordinated changes across the rest of the product.

You own a service from design through long-term operation. That includes defining its API and failure behavior, planning migrations, implementing and deploying it, making it observable, and responding when it fails in production. When a service requires a new underlying mechanism, you work with Systems Engineers while remaining accountable for the service boundary and lifecycle.

What you might work on

Current platform work includes:

  • A durable agent runtime. The current engine runs model and tool loops for Chat, Workflows, automations, and subagents, but active execution is still owned by one process. We are separating the runtime from product-specific state and designing durable runs that can wait for approvals or external events, recover after a process dies, and continue without repeating committed tool calls. This also includes deterministic context reconstruction, compaction, and prompt-cache efficiency.

  • The Model Gateway. We are building one inference boundary for every Langdock product, with a model-agnostic API over managed and customer-provided models. The work includes provider adapters, routing across accounts and regions, rate limits, bounded fallback, streaming safety, usage tracking, and a control plane.

  • Shared services with explicit contracts. We are moving selected capabilities out of a TypeScript monolith into independently operated services with Protobuf and gRPC contracts inside one Bazel monorepo. Our authorization service, written in Go with embedded SpiceDB, is one example: the migration uses an outbox, shadow comparisons on production traffic, and consistency tokens before it becomes authoritative.

  • The integration and tool platform. Langdock already connects to external services through REST APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication. The platform work is to make authentication, token refresh, rate limits, approvals, outbound network safety, and tool execution consistent across these paths.

  • Code execution as a shared service. Langdock already runs untrusted JavaScript, Bash, and Python through separate execution environments. Platform work includes defining a consistent execution API, lifecycle, permission model, resource budgets, and operational boundary, while partnering with Systems Engineers on the underlying isolation and scheduling mechanisms.

  • Production confidence for shared systems. Platform changes need evidence before rollout. Current work includes a reusable load-testing system for HTTP, gRPC, and streaming workloads; structured logging without user content or personally identifiable information (PII); and online database changes for PostgreSQL tables measured in hundreds of gigabytes or terabytes.

You will start in one area based on your experience and the team's priorities, then own its interface and operation in production.

Tech stack

  • TypeScript and a growing set of Go services in one Bazel monorepo

  • Next.js, React, and Tailwind on the front end

  • Node.js services and workers on the back end

  • PostgreSQL with Prisma; Redis with BullMQ

  • Protobuf and gRPC for service contracts

  • Kubernetes across GCP, AWS, Azure, and on-premises deployments

  • Terraform and Terragrunt for infrastructure orchestration

  • Datadog and Sentry for observability

You should be familiar with most of this. We trust you to pick up the rest quickly.

How we work

  • We operate with high trust and autonomy in squads of 3 to 4 engineers. A squad owns its roadmap, prioritization, technical decisions, and operation in production. Engineers are expected to find the context they need, ask for input when it improves the outcome, and move work forward without waiting for every next step to be assigned.

  • We align asynchronously before scheduling a meeting. Product requirement documents (PRDs) define the user problem, intended outcome, and constraints. Design documents make architectural boundaries, tradeoffs, failure modes, migrations, and rollouts explicit. People read and challenge the thinking asynchronously; once the context is shared, a short in-office discussion or whiteboard session usually resolves the remaining questions quickly.

  • We optimize for leverage. Engineers choose the AI tools that work for them, supported by clear ticket context, focused branches, automated tests, and AI review before human review. We also invest in observability, migration tooling, automated recovery, and runbooks so recurring product maintenance does not depend on someone remembering a manual step.

  • The engineer who ships a change owns it in production. If something breaks, you lead the fix.

 

What we are looking for

  • You have several years of experience, typically 3 to 6, building and operating backend systems under real load. You are strong in TypeScript and Node.js and comfortable with Kubernetes, Terraform, networking, databases, and queues. Experience with Go is useful; willingness to work in it matters more.

  • You have strong platform design judgment and approach foundational work with diligence. You can define stable service boundaries and APIs while accounting for data integrity, tenant isolation, backward compatibility, partial failure, and safe rollout.

  • Given an underspecified systems problem, you identify the most important invariant, decide where to go deep, and defend what you deliberately leave out. You investigate unfamiliar components and failure modes until you understand the underlying mechanism.

  • You treat deployment as the start of ownership. You make systems observable, respond when they fail, and turn incidents into lasting improvements while moving with calm urgency and maintaining a high standard.

  • You use AI tools to multiply your output while remaining responsible for the architecture and every change that ships. You share context, ask for input, disagree directly and respectfully, and help other engineers succeed.

 

Working here

This is an in-office role at Greifswalder Strasse 212 in Berlin. We work together in person because it helps us build trust, develop shared context, and make decisions quickly.

Most engineers start around 8:30. We usually eat lunch together, and dinner is available for people who stay later. Running and gym are part of the routine for many of us.

You need an existing right to work in Germany. We do not currently sponsor visas.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is €90,000–€140,000 gross per year. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. Salaries are tied to levels, not negotiation.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - m/f/d
jobs.description:
Where Europe's enterprises adopt AI

Langdock is the AI platform used by more than 10,000 companies to give employees secure access to the leading AI models, to build and share agents and to automate repetitive workflows. We have grown past $40M ARR while remaining a small team, and we care deeply about operating efficiently across the entire company.

For many enterprises, Langdock is becoming the place where most of the net-new work is produced. As people and agents create more documents, analyses, decisions, and automations inside AI interfaces, the context and data behind that work accumulate within Langdock. This gives us the opportunity to earn a larger role in their technology stack by building a platform they choose to rely on.

Our ambition is to build that platform for European enterprises while preserving their control over data, model providers, and deployment environments. We have made meaningful progress at the application layer, but much of the foundation beneath it still needs to be built.

You can watch the Meet the engineering team video to get a feeling for how we work.

The role

Systems Engineers solve our most complex technical problems inside and across Langdock's shared services when existing building blocks or standard architectures are insufficient. These are problems where correctness under failure, performance, scale, security, and cost interact.

This is a project-oriented role rather than ownership of one permanent layer. You might spend a period on distributed execution, then move into storage architecture, workload isolation, or model serving as company priorities change. The constant is sustained investigation of unfamiliar systems and responsibility for turning that understanding into a production system.

Systems Engineers own the difficult mechanism and the measurable improvement it creates, whether in correctness, capability, performance, reliability, or cost. They operate what they build, while the Platform owner remains accountable for the service contract and long-term lifecycle around it.

What you might work on

The systems agenda includes:

  • Distributed state and execution. Design systems that remain correct when work is concurrent, long-running, retried, resumed, or moved between processes. Define explicit invariants for ordering, idempotency, recovery, and tenant isolation.

  • Storage and data systems. Improve how large volumes of customer and agent-generated data are stored, versioned, moved, and recovered while preserving consistency, data residency, and predictable performance.

  • Secure compute for agents. Develop the isolation, runtime, and scheduling mechanisms behind a shared sandbox service for untrusted code. The system needs persistent filesystems, deny-by-default networking, scoped mounts, fast startup, suspension, resumption, and predictable scheduling without weakening the security boundary.

  • Inference systems. Improve the serving systems beneath the Model Gateway, optimizing throughput, latency, accelerator utilization, reliability, and cost. The work is measurement driven: understand the workload, identify the actual bottleneck, and decide where changes to serving, scheduling, caching, model format, or hardware create structural advantage.

  • Resource scheduling and isolation. Make CPU, memory, storage, network, and accelerator capacity explicit so one workload cannot degrade another. Improve placement, admission control, backpressure, autoscaling, and recovery across deployment environments.

  • Billing and usage metering. Build the concurrent metering mechanism behind the billing capability, accounting for heterogeneous units such as model tokens and sandbox compute time. It must stay correct when many workloads report concurrently, events arrive late or more than once, and long-running jobs reserve capacity before their final usage is known. This involves idempotent ingestion, atomic reservations, reconciliation, and auditable records.

You will start with one focused problem based on your experience and the team's priorities. The expectation is not broad activity across every domain; it is a substantial improvement in the capability, performance, reliability, or economics of the system you take on.

Tech stack

  • Go and TypeScript in one Bazel monorepo, with implementation choices driven by the system

  • Linux, containers, microVMs, filesystems, and networking

  • Protobuf and gRPC for service contracts

  • Kubernetes across GCP, AWS, Azure, and on-premises deployments

  • Terraform and Terragrunt for infrastructure orchestration

  • PostgreSQL and Redis where durable metadata or coordination requires them

  • Open-source model serving and accelerator infrastructure

You do not need prior experience with every item. You do need enough systems depth to enter an unfamiliar part of the stack, understand its behavior, and make consequential changes safely.

How we work

  • We operate with high trust and autonomy in squads of 3 to 4 engineers. A squad owns its roadmap, prioritization, technical decisions, and operation in production. Engineers are expected to find the context they need, ask for input when it improves the outcome, and move work forward without waiting for every next step to be assigned.

  • We align asynchronously before scheduling a meeting. Product requirement documents (PRDs) define the user problem, intended outcome, and constraints. Design documents make architectural boundaries, tradeoffs, failure modes, migrations, and rollouts explicit. People read and challenge the thinking asynchronously; once the context is shared, a short in-office discussion or whiteboard session usually resolves the remaining questions quickly.

  • We optimize for leverage. Engineers choose the AI tools that work for them, supported by clear ticket context, focused branches, automated tests, and AI review before human review. We also invest in observability, migration tooling, automated recovery, and runbooks so recurring product maintenance does not depend on someone remembering a manual step.

  • The engineer who ships a change owns it in production. If something breaks, you lead the fix.

What we are looking for

  • You have owned technically difficult production systems in areas such as distributed systems, databases, runtimes, inference, networking, or storage. You operate what you build and remain responsible for it after deployment.

  • You reason from first principles, form testable hypotheses, and use measurement to understand unfamiliar behavior. You investigate beyond the first working solution until you understand the underlying mechanism.

  • Given an underspecified problem, you identify the most important invariant, decide where depth will change the outcome, and defend what you deliberately leave out.

  • You reason precisely about concurrency, isolation, ordering, data loss, and failure, while finding pragmatic ways to improve performance, reliability, or cost without unnecessary complexity.

  • You use AI tools as leverage while verifying their output and retaining ownership of the result. You communicate complex systems clearly, expose uncertainty, and work constructively with others.

Working here

This is an in-office role at Greifswalder Strasse 212 in Berlin. We work together in person because it helps us build trust, develop shared context, and make decisions quickly.

Most engineers start around 8:30. We usually eat lunch together, and dinner is available for people who stay later. Running and gym are part of the routine for many of us.

You need an existing right to work in Germany. We do not currently sponsor visas.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is €90,000–€140,000 gross per year, depending on level and scope. All roles include equity. Salaries are tied to levels, not negotiation.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience.

jobs.title: Regioverantwoordelijke thuisverpleegkundige Home Care Bornem
jobs.description:
Als regioverantwoordelijke thuisverpleging bij Korian krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten binnen een multidisciplinair team. je coördineert en stuurt een team van zelfstandige thuisverplegers aan vanuit het Homecare hoofdkantoor en gaat indien nodig mee op ronde.

Je dagelijkse bezigheden bestaan uit:

  • je voert verpleegkundige handelingen uit volgens de geldende richtlijnen;
  • je coördineert en bewaakt het zorgplan van bewoners;
  • je observeert en rapporteert veranderingen in gezondheidstoestand;
  • je ondersteunt en begeleidt zorgkundigen;
  • je bent aanspreekpunt voor bewoners, familie en artsen;
  • je voert administratieve taken uit in functie van kwalitatieve zorg.

Als regioverantwoordelijke in de thuisverpleging ben je verantwoordelijk bent voor de coördinatie van de dagelijkse werking en het ondersteunen van de zorgverlening. Je draagt bij aan verpleegkundige handelingen, zorgplanning, opvolging van zorgtrajecten en begeleiding van zorgkundigen. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor persoonsgerichte, kwalitatieve zorg en een sterke band met bewoners en familie. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten klinisch inzicht, communicatie en verantwoordelijkheid centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je coördineert, observeert, beslissingen onderbouwt en als aanspreekpunt fungeert.

Verder vragen wij:

  • professionele bachelor verpleegkunde of HBO5 + visum;
  • ervaring: ervaring als verpleegkundige of hoofdverpleegkundige;
  • sterk in zorgplan opvolgen, rapporteren en samenwerken multidisciplinair;
  • goede kennis Nederlands;
  • Rijbewijs B en eigen wagen;
  • flexibel en stressbestendig.
