jobs.title: Kompositmedarbejdere
jobs.description:
Vi søger Kompositmedarbejdere / Støbere til vores stærke team

 

Tuco Marine Group i Faaborg har travlt, og vi søger derfor dygtige komposit medarbejdere og støbere til vores stærke team, som producerer ProZero arbejdsbåde.

Arbejdsopgaverne i stillingen vil bestå af primært komposit arbejde med glasfiber og kulfiber materialer og primært med anvendelse af vacum infusions teknologi.

Kandidaten: Du har solid erfaring inden for komposit produktion. Du har evnen til at arbejde selvstændigt og samarbejde – med et godt overblik for planlægning og udførsel. Du har relevant faglig ballast som sætter dig i stand til at udføre opgaverne både selvstændigt og sammen med dine kollegaer, og evt. underleverandører. - Du har lyst til at arbejde med både og har måske også sejlads og både som din fritidsinteresse. Og er som person kvalitetsbevidst, fleksibel, initiativrig, struktureret og engageret.

Stillingen ligger i vores driftsselskab Tuco Production, hvor vi udvikler, designer og bygger både i letvægtsmaterialer til det professionelle marked. Vi har gennem de senere år lanceret en serie af professionelle både – vores ProZero-linje, som særligt henvender sig til Offshore og Workboat og Forsvars segmenterne. Vi er en virksomhed i vækst og har siden lanceringen af ProZero ansat løbende for at styrke vores allerede stærke hold.

Vi kan tilbyde en dynamisk arbejdsplads i en innovativ virksomhed, der er med helt fremme, når det kommer til udvikling inden for arbejde med maritim innovation, både når det drejer sig om Zero-emission fremdrivning, Autonomi, kompositmaterialer og andre nye og kommende teknologier.

 Vi har ambitiøse vækstmål, og tilbyder en spændende arbejdsplads og de bedste kolleger.

 Ansøgninger kan sendes til job@tuco.dk.

 

 

We are looking for Composites technicians / Molders for our strong team.

 

Tuco Marine Group in Faaborg is busy, and we are therefore looking for skilled composite technicians and molders for our strong team, producing ProZero workboats.

 

The tasks in the position will consist primarily of composite work with fiberglass and carbon fiber materials and primarily with the use of vacuum infusion technology.

 

The candidate: You have solid experience in composite production. You can work independently and collaborate - with a good overview for planning and execution. You have relevant professional ballast that enables you to carry out the work, both independently and together with your colleagues, and possibly subcontractors. - You want to work with boats and perhaps also have sailing and boats as your leisure interest. And as a person is quality-conscious, flexible, proactive, structured, and committed.

 

The position is in our operating company Tuco Production, where we develop, design and build boats in lightweight materials for the professional market. In recent years, we have launched a series of professional boats – our ProZero line, which is particularly aimed at the Offshore and Workboat and Defense segments. We are a growing company and since the launch of ProZero have continuously hired to strengthen our already strong team.

 

We can offer a dynamic workplace in an innovative company that is at the forefront when it comes to development within work with maritime innovation, both when it comes to Zero-emission propulsion, Autonomy, composite materials and other new and upcoming technologies.

 

We have ambitious growth targets and offer an exciting workplace and the best colleagues.

 

Applications can be sent to job@tuco.dk.

jobs.title: Sykepleier i 100 % fast stilling Namdalseid helsehus
jobs.description:
Er du en engasjert sykepleier som ønsker å bruke kompetansen din der den virkelig gjør en forskjell? Vi søker nå etter en sykepleier i 100 % fast stilling til et spennende og utviklingsorientert samarbeid mellom sykehjemmet, omsorgsboligene og hjemmetjenesten på Namdalseid.

Stillingen er ledig for tiltredelse fra august 2026

Stillingen inngår i turnus med dag/aften vakter, med mulighet for langvakter. Du blir en del av et faglig sterkt sykepleiefaglig miljø hvor vi er i gang med et samarbeid på tvers etter prinsippet “sykepleier på topp”. Dette innebærer at sykepleierkompetansen brukes målrettet og riktig, med tydelig faglig ansvar og rom for selvstendige vurderinger. 

Hos oss får du:

  • En variert arbeidshverdag på tvers av tjenester, med tilhørighet på sykehjem
  • Mulighet til å jobbe i langvakter for økt fleksibilitet, 14/17 helger i året, som en del av årsturnus
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø med fokus på kvalitet og pasientsikkerhet
  • Aktiv deltakelse i utvikling av tjenestene
  • Mulighet til å påvirke hvordan sykepleierrollen utøves i praksis

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Utøve helhetlig sykepleie til brukere på sykehjem
  • Kliniske vurderinger, oppfølging og koordinering av pasientforløp
  • Veiledning av kollegaer og samarbeid med pårørende
  • Bidra til fagutvikling og forbedringsarbeid
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid internt og eksternt

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Autorisert sykepleier
  • Gode faglige kunnskaper og kliniske ferdigheter
  • Evne til å arbeide selvstendig og i team og ta ansvar
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og kommunikasjonsegenskaper
  • Interesse for utviklingsarbeid og innovasjon i tjenestene

Generell dataegenskaper

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Vi ser etter deg som er faglig trygg, løsningsorientert og opptatt av kvalitet. Du trives med ansvar og ønsker å bidra aktivt til utvikling av fremtidens helsetjenester.
  • Positiv, arbeidsom og endring- og omstillingsdyktig
  • Gode evner til å ta ansvar for å kvalitetssikre tjenesten i tråd med gjeldene lover og regelverk. 

Hvorfor velge Namdalseid helsehus?

Hos oss får du en rolle hvor du ikke bare utøver sykepleie – du er med og former den. Vi jobber aktivt for at sykepleiere skal få brukt sin kompetanse fullt ut, og vi tror på at de beste løsningene skapes sammen med de som står nærmest pasientene. 

Vi tilbyr:

  • Dyktige, erfarne og engasjerte medarbeidere.
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Grunnlønn etter kommunens lønns- og stillingsregulativ som sykepleier i stillingskode 7174 eller spesialsykepleier stillingskode 7523
  • Som kommunalt ansatt har du rett på en av Norges sikreste pensjonsordninger: offentlig tjenestepensjon. Der de fleste tjenestepensjoner kun utbetales i 10 år, er offentlig tjenestepensjon en utbetaling som varer fra den dagen du slutter å jobbe og livet ut. Pensjonen inkluderer også uføre- og etterlattepensjon hvis noe uventet skulle skje, samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

 I tillegg får du:

  • Rekrutteringstillegg på kr. 10.000 i året for 100 % stilling.
  • Tilbud om rekrutteringstilskudd (engangstilskudd ved ansettelse) på kr 25.000 i 100 % stilling med bindingstid på 2 år. 

Fast stilling eller midlertidig stilling med fast arbeidstid, gis tilleggslønn som delvis kompensasjon for reisekostnader / bomutgifter mellom Steinkjer / Malm og Namsos.

Namsos kommune er en IA-bedrift og opptatt av mangfold. Kommunen oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsvariasjon, nasjonalitet og etnisk bakgrunn. Dokumentasjon på utdanning og praksis skal ikke sendes inn, men legges fram i forbindelse med intervju. Dette gjelder også for interne søkere.

For alle stillinger gjelder de regler som kommer frem av lover, reglement og gjeldende tariffavtale. Det gjøres oppmerksom på at søkerens navn kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren ber om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten, jf. offentlighetslovens 25-2. Eventuell søknad om konfidensiell behandling må begrunnes. Organisasjonen vil være i stadig endring. Det er derfor et krav at den som tilsettes er fleksibel i forhold til endringer i arbeidsoppgaver, samarbeidspartnere og organisatorisk plassering. Søkere som mener å ha fortrinn av stilling, bes opplyse om dette i søknaden jfr. HTA 2.3.1

Søknad sendes:

Søknad med CV sendes elektronisk via knappen "Søk her". Ved behov for veiledning ved utfylling av elektronisk søknad, kontakt Innbyggertorget Namsos kommune.

 Er dette en jobb å flytte til?

Bor du ikke i Namsos kommune, men tenker at denne jobben jammen hørtes spennende ut? Da kan du besøke oss her først – velkommen!

Velkommen til Namsos kommune (video på YouTube)

Namsos kommune på Facebook

Namsos kommunes hjemmeside

Du finner oss også på Instagram og Snap. Eller kanskje du bare like godt skal ta turen og besøke oss?



Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Namdalseid helsetun består av sykeheim, hjemmetjeneste, omsorgsboliger, legekontor og andre kommunale tjenester. Vi holder til i Namdalseid sentrum. Sykeheimen er en del av tilbudet ved helsetunet og har 25 rom og stort fokus på faglig kvalitet til det beste for våre beboere. Dette skjer i god samhandling med andre tjenestetilbud.

jobs.title: PhD Stipend in Intelligent Industrial Energy Systems, Physics-informed AI, digital twins and advanced control
jobs.description:
Help build the systems that will electrify industry
Industrial energy systems are about to change fundamentally. For more than a century, industrial processes have been designed as isolated, deterministic systems. You model them, you optimize them, you operate them. That paradigm is breaking down. As electricity replaces fossil fuels, industrial systems must operate under fundamentally new conditions: fluctuating renewable energy, dynamic electricity prices, and increasing system complexity.

In the future, industrial energy systems will not simply run.

  • They will understand themselves.
  • They will learn from data.
  • They will anticipate and adapt.
  • They will optimize continuously.

At Aalborg University, we are starting to build the scientific foundations for those systems. We are looking for a PhD researcher who wants to be part of that.

The stipend is open for appointment from 15 September 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

What this PhD is really about
This PhD focuses on modelling and controlling electrified industrial thermal systems under real-world conditions. The work is embedded in a collaborative research project with industrial partners, providing access to realistic system configurations, experimental setups and operational data. The scientific ambition is to develop methods that combine physical models and data-driven approaches for adaptive, real-time operation of complex energy systems. Applications such as drying processes serve as test cases, but the goal is to establish methodologies that extend across industrial thermal systems more broadly.

How do we create industrial energy systems that combine physics and data to become adaptive, autonomous and trustworthy?
To get there, you will work at the intersection of thermal energy systems, machine learning and scientific AI, system modelling and identification, as well as optimization and control.

Your work will focus on developing new methods that integrate first-principles models with data-driven learning, supported by reduced-order representations and designed for real-time optimization and control. In essence, this is about physics-informed AI-approaches where physical insight and data reinforce each other rather than compete.

The ambition is to move beyond abstract or idealized solutions. Think digital twins that are not just conceptual, but genuinely useful in practice. Think control systems that can operate robustly under uncertainty, rather than relying on simplified assumptions.

The systems you will be working with are real world, industrial scale energy systems rather than simplified lab set-ups. They include high-temperature, high-power applications, including heat pumps, thermal storage, and complex process units, where both physical understanding and intelligent control are essential.

What you will do
Your day-to-day research will move between theory, modelling and real systems.

  • You will build mathematical and physics-based models of complex thermal systems.
  • You will develop reduced order representations enabling real-time implementation suited for online optimization of operating conditions and control.
  • You will combine the models with data driven learning to adapt to varying operating conditions.
  • You will design control strategies that can operate under real-world constraints.

Some of your work will be purely theoretical. Some of it will be validated against experimental setups and industrial data. You will publish your work, present it internationally, and build a research profile that is relevant far beyond this specific application.

The environment you will step into
You will not be placed inside a narrow, predefined research group. Instead, you will work across a small, complementary team that brings together different pieces of the puzzle:

thermal systems and physical modelling advanced control and system-level thinking industrial electrification and future energy technologies

This is an emerging collaboration, not a finished structure.  This means that you are not just executing a predefined roadmap. You are helping shape the direction.

Your supervisors
You will be supported by a team with different strengths, scientifically and personally.

Henrik Sørensen is Head of Section and your main supervisor. His focus is not only on research, but on building researchers. He will push you, give you space, and expect you to grow into an independent scientist.

Henrik C. Pedersen is Vice Head of Research and one of the key profiles within modelling and control at AAU. He will challenge your thinking, sharpen your methods and connect your work to a broader scientific context.

Anna Lyhne Jensen represents the next generation of energy researchers.
Her work focuses on electrification of industrial processes and future thermal systems, and she is deeply engaged in the green transition. She will be your closest collaborator in many parts of the project.

Together, the team is not uniform, and that is exactly the point. No single discipline can solve this problem.

Who you are
You likely have a background in energy engineering, mechanical engineering, control, applied mathematics, physics or a related field.

But more importantly, we are looking for someone who:

  • Has a strong curiosity about how complex systems actually work.
  • Is comfortable with mathematical modelling and analytical thinking.
  • Is motivated to combine physical insight with data-drive methods.
  • Enjoys building models and methods – not just analyzing existing ones.
  • Has the ambition and persistence to tackle difficult problems and carry them through.

This is a demanding PhD. It requires both independence and engagement, and a willingness to work at the intersection of disciplines. You don’t need to know everything from the start - but you should have a clear drive to develop expertise and contribute at a high scientific level.

What you get out of it
This PhD is not just about writing three papers and moving on. It is about building a profile that sits at the intersection of energy systems, AI & modelling and optimization & control. That combination is rare, and extremely valuable, both in academia and industry.

  • You will work with real systems, real data and real problems.
  • You will collaborate with industry.
  • You will be part of the broader European research landscape in energy and sustainability.

And you will have a high degree of freedom to shape your own direction.

Why this matters
Industrial heat is one of the hardest parts of the green transition. Electrification alone is not enough. If we cannot control and optimize these systems intelligently, we will not unlock their full potential. This PhD is about contributing to these missing pieces.

Expected starting date is 15 September 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Interested?
If you want to work on something that is technically challenging, scientifically interesting, and actually matters — we would like to hear from you. Applications should include a CV, transcripts and a short motivation.

For further information, feel free to contact:

Henrik Sørensen, hs@energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at: the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus.
AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Director Communication (Flexible Location)
jobs.description:
Are you ready to help shape how the world sees Seco? We’re entering an exciting new chapter for our Brand, Marketing and Communication function, one global unified team, built to keep the Seco brand top of mind for our key target audiences – and to accelerate the company strategy. We’re looking for a seasoned communications leader to join us as Director Communication and take our story telling, reputation and stakeholder engagement to the next level.

As a member of the Brand, Marketing and Communication Management Team, you work closely with Seco’s executive leadership and play a key role in shaping the future of our communication function. Be part of a people-centric culture with opportunities for professional growth within Seco and the wider Sandvik Group.

About the job

This is a unique opportunity to build, shape and further develop a future team of four team members, in a newly established communication department. As Director of Communication, you lead our global communication agenda across internal and external audiences. You design and drive an integrated communication strategy that builds trust with customers, partners and employees, while turning transformation into a clear and compelling story inside and outside the company. You’re a member of the leadership team and report to the Vice President Brand, Marketing and Communication.

Job responsibilities

Your profile

You bring a growth mindset, personal accountability, and a genuine belief in winning together, which is essential as you will help influence the direction of the newly established Brand, Marketing and Communication function alongside with your peers in the Management Team. jobs.title: Barnevernkonsulent
jobs.employer: FELLES BARNEVERNTENESTE FOR VANG OG VESTRE SLIDRE KOMMUNE
jobs.description:
Felles barnevernteneste for Vang og Vestre Slidre kommune har eit ledig vikariat i 100 % stilling med snarleg oppstart og fram til 31.12.2027, med moglegheit for forlenging eller fast tilsetting.

Er du ein engasjert fagperson og ynskjer å vere del av eit fagmiljø der du kan gjere ein positiv skilnad? Vi søker deg som ynskjer varierte barnevernfaglege oppgåver i eit miljø med erfarne tilsette som er opptatt av utvikling, samarbeid og med eit høgt fagleg fokus! 

Opplysningar om arbeidsstaden og stillinga:

Felles barnevernteneste for Vang og Vestre Slidre kommune er ei interkommunal teneste der Vestre Slidre er vertskommune. Tenesta består av 8,1 årsverk og har godt utdanna og engasjerte fagfolk. Tenesta er organisert under avdelinga Familie, helse og førebygging. Barneverntenesta har fokus på å tilby tiltak for barn, unge og familiar der dei bur og vi har fokus på korleis vi organiserer tenesta for å sikre kvalitet og effektivitet i sakshandsaminga. Det vert lagt vekt på tverrfagleg samarbeid med andre tenester. 

Tenesta jobbar etter generalistmodellen, som omfattar oppgåver knytt til mottak, akuttarbeid, undersøking, hjelpetiltak, omsorgstiltak/fosterheim og ettervern. Du får difor ein variert kvardag og brei erfaring som barnevernkonsulent.

Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Undersøking og oppfølging av hjelpe- og omsorgstiltak
  • Dokumentering og sakshandsaming av det barnevernsfaglege arbeidet i tråd med lovkrava
  • Partsrepresentant i Fylkesnemnda og øvrige rettsinstansar
  • Deltaking i barnevernfagleg akuttarbeid
  • Samarbeid med interne og eksterne samarbeidspartar
  • Aktiv deltaking i utviklinga av tenesta sitt faglege arbeid
  • Andre oppgåver kan bli tillagt stillinga
Kvalifikasjonar
  • - 3-årig relevant utdanning på høgskule- eller universitetsnivå, fortrinnsvis som barnevernspedagog, sosionom eller vernepleiar. 
    - Påbegynt eller fullført masterutdanning eller anna relevant vidareutdanning er ein fordel, men ikkje eit krav. 
    - Det er ynskjeleg med erfaring innan kommunal barnevernteneste. 
    - Førarkort klasse B (Krav)
Personlege eigenskapar

Vi ynskjer deg som:

  • har god relasjonskompetanse
  • kan uttrykke deg godt munnleg og skriftleg
  • har evne til å arbeide sjølvstendig, målretta og strukturert
  • har gode samarbeidsevner både internt og mot eksterne aktørar
  • er fleksibel, robust og har høg arbeidskapasitet
  • har eit fagleg engasjement
  • er trygg, raus og varm i fagutøvinga
  • vil bidra til gode tverrfaglege løysingar
  • er digitalt kompetent og har interesse for dette
Vi tilbyr
  • Kommunen kan legge til rette for vidareutdanning viss ynskeleg
  • Løn etter tariff. Som eit rekrutteringstiltak tilbyr vi minimum 10 års ansiennitet
  • Ellers gjeld arbeidsvilkår etter dei reglar som til ei kvar tid går fram av gjeldande lover, reglement og tariffavtalar
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Spennande og meningsfylte arbeidsoppgåver
  • Eit engasjert og kompetent arbeidsmiljø
  • Fagleg og personleg utvikling med støtte frå erfarne fagpersonar
  • Vestre Slidre og Vang ligg i sentralitetsklasse 5 og 6, og ved å bu i ein av desse kommunane kan du etter eitt år få sletta 25 000 kroner av studielånet ditt kvart år.
Kontaktinformasjon

Melanie Degen, Tenesteleiar Familie, helse og førebygging, 949 78 343

Arbeidsstad

Slidrevegen 16
2966 SLIDRE

Nøkkelinformasjon:

Arbeidsgivar: Vestre Slidre kommune

Referansenr.: 5160485687
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Vikar
Søknadsfrist: 03.09.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Andre opplysningar

 Eit godt arbeidsmiljø er prega av mangfald. Vi oppmodar alle kvalifiserte kandidatar til å søkje uavhengig av kjønn, funksjonsevne eller kulturell bakgrunn. Arbeidsplassen vil bli tilrettelagt ved behov. Det vert gjort merksam på at namnet på ein søkjar kan bli gjort offentleg sjølv om søkjaren har bedt om at namnet blir unnteke offentleg søkjarliste. Ynskje om unntak frå offentleg søkjarliste må grunngjevast i søknaden, jf. offentleglova § 25, andre ledd. Søkjaren vert varsla dersom ynskje ikkje kan takast til følgje.

 

Vestre Slidre kommune er ein landbruks- og reiselivskommune i Valdres, og som ligg vakkert til nær Jotunheimen, er 457 km2 stor og har omlag 2 100 innbyggjarar. Vi har ei god skule, full barnehagedekning og ei av dei beste kulturskulane i landet. Kommunen har også eit rikt kulturliv med song, musikk og idrett, og eit vidt spekter innanfor lag og foreiningar.

Her ligg det til rette for aktivt friluftsliv - både sommar og vinter. Største delen av fjellområda i kommunen er statsallmenning. For jakt- og fiskeinteresserte byr dette på mange gode - som for eksempel fiske med garn og oter i alle vatn i allmenningen, og tilgang til småviltjakt. Vestre Slidre kommune kan også by på eit alpinanlegg og 300 km oppkøyrte skiløyper i vårt vakre og varierte fjellområde, samt to lysløypeanlegg. Det er god kommunikasjon til Oslo og Vestlandet via E-16, som går gjennom kommunen.

Flytte til Valdres? Sjå http://www.velgvaldres.no

jobs.description:
Vi søker en trygg, omsorgsfull og ansvarsbevisst person som ønsker en meningsfull jobb som BPA-assistent på Sekken. Stillingen passer for deg som søker fast jobb, tilkallingsvikar eller ferievikar, og som trives med en variert arbeidshverdag der du får bidra med både praktisk hjelp og personlig støtte.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Dyre- og fjøsstell
  • Matlaging
  • Bistand til personlig hygiene
  • Renhold i hjemmet
  • Annen praktisk hjelp i det daglige

 

Om rollen

Som BPA-assistent blir du en viktig støtte i hverdagen og bidrar til å skape trygghet, struktur og gode opplevelser. Arbeidet krever at du er fleksibel, rolig og respektfull, og at du møter mennesker med forståelse og engasjement. Personen du skal bistå er en voksen kvinne med sammensatte bistandsbehov, og vi ser derfor etter deg som er pålitelig og komfortabel med å bidra både praktisk og personlig.

Kvalifikasjoner

Du må beherske norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig. Førerkort klasse B er en stor fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav for den rette kandidaten.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Vi oppfordrer deg til å søke og ser frem til å høre fra deg.


Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Responsable des opérations Adjoint (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
LHH Recruitment Solutions, cabinet de conseil en recrutement et évaluation d'experts, cadres et dirigeants, recrute pour son client, acteur majeur de la logistique et du transport, un Responsable Adjoint des Opérations Transport Multimodal H/F, pour une mission intérim de 6 mois minimum, basée à Blagnac (31).

Au sein d'un environnement Supply Chain Optimization (4PL), vous intervenez sur un périmètre stratégique visant à piloter et optimiser les opérations de transport multimodal, avec une dominante route.

Ainsi, vos missions principales seront :
- Superviser les opérations de transport multimodal, avec un focus sur le transport routier domestique et international
- Planifier, piloter et suivre l'ensemble des flux logistiques dans un environnement 4PL / Lead Logistics Provider
- Garantir le respect des SLA, KPI et engagements clients
- Gérer les incidents transport et mettre en place des plans d'actions correctifs
- Optimiser les coûts et la performance globale des opérations
- Piloter les relations avec les transporteurs et partenaires logistiques
- Négocier les conditions opérationnelles et contractuelles et suivre la performance fournisseurs
- Manager, accompagner et développer une équipe opérationnelle
- Organiser la planification et la répartition des activités
- Déployer une culture de performance et d'amélioration continue
- Piloter l'optimisation des processus transport et contribuer à la digitalisation (TMS, reporting, dashboards)
- Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des clients stratégiques et proposer des solutions d'optimisation logistique

Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en logistique, transport ou supply chain, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative de 5 ans minimum en transport et logistique, avec une expertise en transport routier national et international, sur des fonctions managériales.

Une expérience en environnement 4PL ou en pilotage de transporteurs multiples est fortement appréciée.
Vous maîtrisez les outils TMS ainsi que le pack Microsoft Office (Excel avancé, PowerPoint) et avez une bonne connaissance des KPI et du pilotage de la performance opérationnelle.
La connaissance des réglementations transport international et export control est un plus.
Un niveau bilingue français et anglais est indispensable. Une troisième langue serait appréciée.

Ce poste est une mission d'intérim à pourvoir à partir du mois de novembre, pour 6 mois, à Blagnac (31), statut Cadre.
Rémunération selon profil.

jobs.description:
Reports to: Dean of Students

﻿

Our vision

To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers.

Our mission

Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond.

Description/Purpose

A Learning Support teacher helps design and implement interventions for students with learning needs.

Duties/Responsibilities

    Collaborating with the subject teachers to set targets and strategies and accommodations needed by the identified students.
    Create individualized, strategic lessons and interventions for the student.
    Help students to cope with and overcome problems that arise because of learning difficulties.
    Use adaptive technology and targeted intervention programs to maximise individual learning potential.
    Work with students within a class and in small groups.
    Progress monitor and collect data to measure student progress and appropriateness of student support.
    Planning, collaborating and implementing ILP’s.
    Adapting  PYP / primary school program and conventional teaching methods to meet individual needs.
    Working as a team-member within the Department and wider school staff and liaising with other relevant individuals such as educational psychologists, parents and other specialists that compose a multidisciplinary team.
    Providing professional development and classroom strategies to teachers that will improve the classroom performance and student achievement.

Required Qualifications, Attributes and Experience

    Qualified SPED teacher or Qualified teacher with specialised SPED related training.
    Experience as a Learning Support Teacher in Primary school is an advantage.
    Experience of IB curriculum is an advantage.
    Self-motivation, creativity and enthusiasm.
    Experience in working with/ awareness of local laws.
    Experience and flexibility working in an international school environment.
    Excellent communication, collaboration and organizational skills.
    A strong ability to establish good rapport with students and adults.
    Ability to maintain confidentiality.
    Ability to view students with unconditional positive regard.
    Ability to show initiative and to work independently.
    Ability to administer assessments.
    Fluent in English (reading, writing, speaking).

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer:

As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation.

Salary:

Individually negotiated.

**Haemme nyt liikenteenohjaajia ratikkatyömaille pääkaupunkiseudulle!**

Työt alkavat heti!

Keitä olemme?

Ramudden luo kokonaisvaltaisia työturvallisuusratkaisuja tietöihin, rakennuksiin, tiloihin, rautateille ja erilaisiin infrastruktuurin projekteihin. Teemme työmme turvallisesti ja välittäen!

Ketä haemme?

Haemme liikenteenohjaajia useille työmaille pääkaupunkiseudulle! Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön. Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa se, että sinä ja kaikki muut liikenteessä liikkujat pääsevät turvallisesti töihin tai kouluun sekä takaisin kotiin. Minne sitten olettekin matkalla, turvaamme matkasi!

Mitä työ sisältää?

Liikenteenohjaajan työhön kuuluu varmistaa työmaan läpikulkevan liikenteen turvallinen kulku ja eteneminen niin kauan, kun työmaa on olemassa. Liikenteenohjauksessa työskennellään useimmiten pareittain ja ohjataan liikennettä vuorotellen. Pidämme huolta myös kollegoistamme.

Mitä vaaditaan?

Sinun tulee olla täysi-ikäinen Sinulla tulee olla normaalit aistit: näkö, kuulo ja reaktiokyky Sinulla tulee olla vähintään AM121 tai B-luokan ajokortti Odotamme liikenteenohjaajiltamme myös hyvää liikennetuntemusta.

jobs.title: Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner to shape St1's CRM approach and deliver the Salesforce-based solutions that support our sales, customer service, and business operations. This role sits where business needs meet technical delivery: you make sure what we build is scalable, secure, and actually adopted by the people who use it.

A big part of the role is partnering with business teams who are actively developing their digital ways of working. You act as a trusted advisor, drawing on experience from multiple Salesforce implementations to guide teams, introduce best practices, and drive real process change and adoption, not just deliver features.

You work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and administrators, translating requirements into a prioritized backlog and actionable solutions. This is a hands-on role: it combines business analysis with real configuration work in Salesforce, so you are as comfortable writing a user story as you are building in the platform.

How youll help drive the change

Joining St1, youll be part of running and developing a profitable business that invests in long-term energy solutions. Together we achieve the extraordinary through everyday work. As a Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud Technical Product Owner, youll play a key role in

Product Strategy & Vision

Define and communicate the roadmap for Salesforce Sales & Service Cloud capabilities.

Align platform initiatives with business objectives and customer experience goals.

Continuously evaluate new Salesforce features and innovations for business value.

Backlog & Requirements Management

Own and maintain the Sales & Service product backlog.

Gather, analyze, and prioritize business and technical requirements.

Translate business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and keep backlog items well-defined and ready for development.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical guidance on Salesforce architecture, integrations, and configurations.

Partner with architects and developers to design scalable, secure solutions, and review designs against best practices and enterprise standards.

Configure Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud hands-on where needed.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Act as the primary liaison between business users, Business Technology, and external vendor teams.

Design and facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and process improvements that help business teams build confidence and capability.

Manage expectations and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies.

Partner with business leads to drive user adoption: coaching teams through change, addressing resistance, and building long-term ownership of new ways of working.

Share insights and best practices from prior implementations to help the business make informed decisions and avoid common pitfalls.

Platform Governance & Quality

Ensure compliance with security, data, and governance standards.

Promote best practices for development, documentation, and deployment.

What you bring to the team

Were looking for a colleague with the drive to challenge, collaborate and grow. To thrive in this role, you likely have:

5+ years of experience working with Salesforce platforms, including 3+ years in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, or Technical Lead role.

Proven hands-on experience configuring Salesforce Sales and Service Cloud.

Strong understanding of CRM, sales operations, and customer service processes.

Demonstrated experience driving organizational change and process adoption in environments with varying levels of digital maturity.

Track record of delivering Salesforce implementations across multiple organizations, with the ability to bring cross-industry best practices to new contexts.

A bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have: Salesforce certifications (e.g. Administrator, Platform Developer, Sales/Service Cloud Consultant), experience with Einstein or Agentforce, and experience in large-scale, highly integrated environments.

Who are we looking for

We are looking for your passion, skills and drive. We're looking for those who recognize the St1 Spirit in themselves: Curious, Commercial, Committed and Caring. We value people who are curious, commercial, committed and caring, and who thrive in collaborative, fast-changing environments.

Why Join St1?

- Shape St1s CRM vision and create tangible impact across sales and customer service.
- Blend business insight with hands-on design and delivery.
- Influence how teams adopt modern digital ways of working.
- Develop into Salesforce architecture, AI-powered CRM, or product leadership.
- Helsinki or Stockholm base, with excellent social benefits.
- Work in a high-performing Nordic tech organisation built on trust and responsibility.

How we support your journey

At St1, your safety and wellbeing come first. We offer an open and inclusive workplace where youre respected and trusted to take initiative. In a hands-on, informal culture - and a business that never stands still - theres room to explore ideas and take on new challenges. We support your journey through learning and opportunities to grow across teams and countries.

Youll have real ownership of St1's CRM platform and how it's used, working with a wide range of teams; backed by competitive pay, a bonus scheme and genuine opportunities to grow your career.

If youd like to explore more about our culture, visit our career site.

What to expect after you apply

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive and equitable recruitment process.

Interested? Send us your CV and cover letter via the Barona Career site no later than Thursday, 14 August 2026. For more information, please reach out to us during the August calling times: Tuesday, 4 of August or Thursday, 6 August 2026 between noon and 2 pm.

Contact person is Baronas Recruitment Team Lead Lassi Jyrinsalo via email at lassi.jyrinsalo@barona.fi.

Lets challenge the ordinary!

Une première expérience en relation client ou en vente est un atout.

Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français et les outils numériques.

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: R&D Software Developer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We’re Hiring: R&D Software Engineer | Hitachi Energy Do you want to develop software that helps power some of the world's most critical energy infrastructure? Join the MACH Infrastructure & Tools team at Hitachi Energy and work at the intersection of software engineering, industrial automation, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. You'll be part of a collaborative engineering team developing and evolving a strategically important in-house application used across our HVDC business. Unlike many corporate software roles, you'll have the opportunity to work across the complete software lifecycle and gain real ownership from day one.

This role offers the opportunity to work on software that directly supports critical infrastructure, contributing to solutions that have a real impact on the reliability and security of essential systems. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers and technical specialists, gaining valuable insights and hands-on experience in industrial digitalization, operational technology (OT) environments, networking, and cybersecurity.

Working in a quality-focused engineering environment, you'll leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to design and deliver innovative solutions. The position also provides excellent opportunities for professional growth, with potential career paths leading to roles such as Technical Lead, Product Owner, or Design Architect.

How you’ll make an impact

    Design, develop, test, and maintain industrial software applications using C#, .NET and Python technologies.
    Collaborate with architects, project managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
    Support continuous improvement of software development processes, quality standards, and engineering practices
    Contribute to reliability, cybersecurity, and long-term maintainability of software supporting critical infrastructure solutions.
    Participate in technical investigations, troubleshooting activities, and feature development across the software lifecycle.
    Build technical ownership of strategic applications and help drive future product and platform evolution.

Your background

    B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
    Experience with software development using C#, .NET and/or Python.
    Knowledge of desktop application development; experience with MVVM architecture is considered an advantage.
    Strong analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and willingness to learn new technologies and domains.
    Collaborative and self-driven personality with a high degree of ownership and accountability
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken; Swedish is considered an advantage.

What we offer

    Collective agreement
    Flexible working time
    Health care and wellness allowance
    Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
    Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
    Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
    Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
    Supplementary compensation for parental leave
    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

More about us

jobs.title: Ung og aktiv gutt utvider teamet
jobs.description:
Jeg søker nå kule og sporty mennesker som ønsker å bidra med engasjement i livet mitt.


Om meg:

Er bosatt i Haugesund med familien min og vår lille hund. Jeg liker alt i fra kino, bowling, fisketurer, sykkelturer og turer i skog og mark.

 

Om stillingen: 

Du må kunne jobbe selvstendig, men også kunne være omgjengelig når vi er med andre. Jeg klarer mye selv, men er avhengig av at en voksen kan være der for å veilede.

Jeg ønsker løsningsorienterte og kreative mennesker som kan være en støtte og venn, men samtidig setter krav og grenser for å styrke selvstendigheten på vei mot voksenlivet.

Som BPA-assistent jobber du turnus, inkludert arbeid på ettermiddag, kveld og helg. Dette kan tilpasses hver enkelt søker og det er muligheter for å kombinere stillingen med annen jobb. Prima Assistanse blir din arbeidsgiver, mens opplæring og oppfølging gis av oss foreldre.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver:

·        Veiledning og støtte

·        Følge på aktiviteter

·        Praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet

·        Utføre daglige rutiner og oppgaver

·        Bidra til aktiviteter, lek og moro

Personlige egenskaper:

·        Ansvarsfull, fleksibel, trygg og selvstendig i arbeid

·        Tålmodighet

·        Raushet

·        Personlig egnethet og kjemi blir vektlagt

Kvalifikasjoner:

·        Plettfri vandel

·        Førerkort: Klasse B

·        Gode norskkunnskaper

Prima Assistanse tilbyr:

·        En meningsfylt jobb som fremmer likestilling

·        Gode arbeids- og lønnsbetingelser gjennom tariffavtale

·        Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging av lokalkontor

·        En selvstendig jobb med varierte oppgaver.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: QA Tester
jobs.description:
Your New Role

We are looking for a curious and detail-oriented QA Tester to join an innovative team working with hardware integrations and connected devices. You will play an important role in ensuring that devices running digital integrations provide a high-quality user experience.

Your responsibilities will include setting up new devices and companion apps, executing manual and exploratory tests, writing clear and reproducible bug reports, and maintaining test cases as software and integrations evolve. You will also perform regression testing following fixes and new releases, summarise test results, and communicate with external partners regarding certification outcomes and next steps. In addition, you will help identify recurring issues and suggest improvements to testing processes.

The position can be offered as either one full-time assignment or two part-time positions, making it particularly suitable for students looking to combine work with their studies.

Company Presentation

Our client is a globally recognised technology and entertainment company operating at the forefront of digital products and services. The company develops innovative solutions used by millions of people worldwide and collaborates with partners to deliver seamless experiences across a wide range of devices and platforms. You will join a collaborative and international environment where quality, curiosity and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Good to Know

Scope of employment: 50–100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters Working model: On-site in Stockholm Salary: According to agreement Start date: As agreed End date: 6-month contract, with possibility of extension In your application: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client

To succeed in this role, you will need:

    

Technical education or equivalent technical knowledge

    

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

    

A curious, structured and detail-oriented approach

    

Good problem-solving skills and an ability to work collaboratively

    

Initiative and willingness to identify and drive improvements

    

Ability to work on-site in Stockholm and flexibility regarding working hours

What we Offer

    

Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension

    

Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex

    

Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service

    

Additional compensation during parental leave

    

Occupational health services

    

Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support

    

Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

We look forward to receiving your application

We review applications on an ongoing basis. As recruitment processes in the consulting industry can move quickly, the position may be filled before the advertised deadline — so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

You do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, please respond to the screening questions included in the application process.

jobs.title: Guide
jobs.description:
Activity Guide

We are now looking for an **Activity Guide** to join our team. In this role, you will be at the heart of our international activity operations – safely guiding our guests through unique nature experiences and contributing to the development of our activity services.

What we offer

- Meaningful work with one of the pioneers of tourism in Lapland, where sustainability and quality are at the heart of everything we do.

- An inspiring working environment: in your free time, you can enjoy the peace and beauty of Laplands nature – skiing, hiking, fishing or watching the Northern Lights.

- The support of an encouraging work community: you will work in an international environment with the warm and relaxed atmosphere of a family-owned company.

- A wide range of staff benefits and opportunities for personal and professional development.

- Staff accommodation can be arranged if needed.


Your responsibilities

- Safely and professionally guiding guests on a variety of activities, such as snowshoeing, snowmobile safaris, Northern Lights excursions and ice fishing.

- Ensuring excellent guest experiences through warm, clear communication and professional service.

- Preparing equipment and maintaining activity areas.

- Working in the equipment storage and service area.

- Following safety guidelines and company procedures.

- Supporting the development of activity products and daily operations.

- Reporting to the Activity Manager.


Who are we looking for?

You are responsible, proactive and passionate about the outdoors and customer service. You enjoy seasonal work where no two days are exactly the same and thrive in an international environment.

You have:

- Solid experience in guiding or outdoor activities; previous experience in Lapland is considered an advantage.

- Good physical fitness and a safety-first mindset.

- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

- Excellent communication and customer service skills.

- Fluency in English; other language skills, such as Finnish, German or French, are considered an advantage.

- A valid Category B driving licence.

- A willingness to learn and develop your skills.


Ready for an adventure?

If you have a passion for nature, adventure and creating unforgettable guest experiences, you might be the person we are looking for.

**Start date:** Late November.

If this sounds like you and you are interested in joining our team, send us your application and CV. We would love to hear from you!

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris is a family-owned pioneer of tourism in Lapland, located in Muonio in Fell Lapland, close to the Swedish border. Founded in 1973 as a camping and caravan site on the banks of the Tornio–Muonio River, Europes longest free-flowing river, Harriniva has grown into three full-service resorts surrounded by the pristine nature of Lapland.

Today, Harriniva Hotels & Safaris consists of **Harriniva Adventure Resort**, **Jeris Lakeside Resort** and **Torassieppi Eco Reindeer Resort**.

Every day, our team works to deliver on our promise: **Best in Wilderness**. At Harriniva, we do our utmost to ensure that every guest experiences the unique nature of Lapland in an unforgettable way – taking home lasting memories and the feeling of being at their best in the wilderness.

jobs.title: Spotters in Vaasa/ Spotteri Vaasaan
jobs.description:
Spotters wanted for a large construction site in Vaasa

We are looking for spotters to join a large construction project in Vaasa.

As a spotter, you will play a key role in maintaining safety on the construction site while heavy machinery is in operation. Your main responsibility is to ensure that machine operators can work safely, especially in situations where their visibility is limited or when work is being carried out close to structures, pedestrians, or traffic routes. You will help ensure that the work progresses safely and efficiently.

This is a full-time position. Working hours are Monday to Friday, with shorter shifts on Saturdays (7:00-13:00). Please be prepared to work longer hours when needed.

Please note: This position requires English language skills (Finnish language is an advantage).

What we are looking for:

You are likely to succeed in this role if you have:

* Access to a car, as the construction site is difficult to reach by public transportation

* Good command of English

* Previous experience in construction, manufacturing, or assembly work

* A valid Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti), or willingness to obtain one

* A safety-first mindset and commitment to safe working practices

* A reliable, responsible, and careful approach to work

A positive attitude is just as important as experience. If youre motivated, dependable, and enjoy working as part of a team, wed love to hear from you.

What we offer:

* Competitive salary, always in accordance with the applicable collective agreement at a minimum

* All necessary tools and work equipment provided

* Support with obtaining any required safety cards or certifications

* A reliable employer that keeps its promises and values fair treatment

We offer clear expectations, a supportive team, and a workplace where its easy to feel welcome.

Interested? Wed love to hear from you!

If this opportunity sounds like a good fit and youd like to become part of the Lisäpalvelu team, submit your application as soon as possible.

We review applications continuously and begin interviews immediately with suitable candidates. The start date will be agreed upon with the selected applicants.

Why choose Lisäpalvelu?

1. Personal Service
We provide genuinely personal support throughout your job search and employment. Youll meet us face-to-face during the recruitment process, and once youre employed through us, youll have a dedicated contact person to assist you with any employment-related matters.

2. Wide Range of Opportunities
Our extensive network of construction industry clients allows us to offer a broad variety of positions suitable for different skills and experience levels.

3. Ongoing Employment Opportunities
Thanks to our large client base, new assignments are available continuously. When one project ends, you may have the opportunity to move directly to another, depending on your skills and experience.

4. A Reliable Employer
We keep our promises and handle the administrative details, so you can focus on your work with confidence.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

About Lisäpalvelu

Founded in 2002, Lisäpalvelu is a Finnish staffing and recruitment company providing flexible workforce solutions nationwide. We are known for our reliability and long-term relationships with both employees and clients.

Each year we employ more than 3,000 people across a wide range of industries, including hospitality, construction, manufacturing, maintenance, logistics, office administration, cleaning, and retail.

jobs.title: Lun og koselig dame søker ny ansatt
jobs.description:
Vi søker stødige og pliktoppfyllende mennesker som ønsker å bidra med positivt engasjement i livet til en glad dame i 50-årene. Stillingen kan deles opp, og vi har også behov for ferievikarer i sommer med snarlig oppstart.

Om henne:

Denne hyggelige damen bor på fastlands-Karmøy i egen bolig. Hun har behov for assistanse knyttet til både fysiske utfordringer, samt veiledning og motivasjon i hverdagen. Hun bruker rullestol, og setter stor pris på å komme seg ut på turer.

Hun elsker utflukter, spesielt kjøreturer i egen bil – enten det er for å dra på konsert eller bare for å få litt frisk luft og nye inntrykk. Hun er også glad i strikking, noe hun gjerne koser seg med foran TV-en. Musikk og sosialt samvær står høyt i kurs hos denne humørfylte og positive damen.

Om stillingen:

Det er behov for assistanse tilsvarende ca. 37 % stilling, men stillingen kan deles opp i mindre deler dersom det er ønskelig.

Vi søker også tilkallingsvikarer, samt ferievikarer for sommeren med rask oppstart.

Arbeidet innebærer turnus med dag-, kveld- og helgevakter.

Som BPA-assistent må du kunne jobbe selvstendig og være fleksibel. Damen er avhengig av hjelp til både praktiske og personlige behov, samt støtte, veiledning og motivasjon i hverdagen. Vi ser etter løsningsorienterte og kreative personer som bidrar positivt og ser muligheter fremfor begrensninger.

Prima Assistanse vil være din arbeidsgiver, mens opplæring og oppfølging gis av familien.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Veiledning og støtte
  • Personlig stell
  • Følge til og på aktiviteter
  • Praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet
  • Utføre daglige rutiner
  • Bidra til en god og meningsfull hverdag
  • Legge til rette for sosiale aktiviteter

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Ansvarsfull, fleksibel og trygg
  • Selvstendig i arbeid
  • Tålmodig og raus
  • Personlig egnethet og god kjemi vektlegges

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Plettfri vandel
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Gode norskkunnskaper


Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Kotipalveluyrittäjäksi Ouluun ja lähialueelle
jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja motivoitunutta Kotipalveluyrittäjää liittymään osaavien Kotirinki-yrittäjien joukkoon. Tarjoamme sinulle valmiita asiakkaita alkuun sekä mahdollisuuden rakentaa omaa menestystäsi joustavasti.

Työ sisältää: Siivouspalvelut arkipäivisin asiakkaiden kodeissa esimerkiksi säännöllisesti tehtävät ylläpitosiivoukset tai kertaluoteisia palveluita kuten teho- ja muuttosiivouksia tai ikkunoidenpesua. Tehtäviisi sisältyy myös ikäihmisten Kotiapupalvelut, kuten asiointiapuun, seuranpitoon ja arjen tukitehtäviin, sinulla tulee myös olla siihen soveltuvuutta ja kiinnostusta

Edellytämme: Vähintään B-ajokorttia (Suomalainen ajo-oikeus) ja auton käyttömahdollisuus Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, minimi taso B2 (asiakasviestintä tapahtuu suomeksi suullisesti ja kirjallisesti) Nuhteeton tausta ja luottotiedot kunnossa Hyvä fyysinen ja henkinen kunto

Arvostamme: Asiakaspalveluasennetta ja aitoa halua auttaa Kiinnostusta markkinointiin ja oman toiminnan kehittämiseen Valmiin toimintamallin arvostamista Tahtoa menestyä yrittäjänä ja tehdä töitä yhdessä.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä osana lämminhenkistä ja tyytyväistä Kotirinkiläisten joukkoa. Jos tunnet kutsumusta auttaa ihmisiä arjessa ja haluat rakentaa omaa yrittäjyyttäsi tuetusti ja kannustavasti tämä voi olla juuri sinulle!

Joustavat aikataulut ja itsenäisyys: Päätä itse, milloin ja kuinka paljon haluat työskennellä. Tämä työ joustaa elämäntilanteesi mukaan mahdollisuus rauhallisiin aamuihin, aikaisiin iltapäiviin tai vapaiden viikonloppujen suunnitteluun on omissa käsissäsi.

Vahva tuki markkinointiin ja asiakashankintaan: Saat käyttöösi valmiin verkkokaupan ja nautit Kotiringin tekemästä markkinointi- ja myyntityöstä, joka tukee yrityksesi kasvua. Vaikutat omaan menestykseesi omilla paikallisilla markkinointitoimilla ja aktiivisella asiakastyöllä.

Valmis konsepti ja helppokäyttöiset työvälineet: Kotiringin kehittämät järjestelmät tekevät yrittäjyydestä yksinkertaista. Hallinnolliset työt, kuten laskutus ja työvuorosuunnittelu, hoituvat muutamalla klikkauksella, joten aikaa jää itse työlle, asiakkaille ja omasta vapaasta ajasta nauttimiseen.

Koulutus ja jatkuva tuki: Oli sinulla aiempaa kokemusta alalta tai ei, Kotirinki kouluttaa sinut tuottamaan kotipalveluitamme konseptimme mukaisesti. Tukemme ja kattavat ohjeemme varmistavat, että onnistut laadukkaan palvelun tuottamisessa yrittäjänä.

Kenelle Kotirinki-yrittäjyys sopii? Tämä mahdollisuus on sinulle, joka: Haluat itsenäisyyttä ja vapautta päättää omasta ajankäytöstäsi. Nautit asiakkaiden auttamisesta ja heidän arkeensa vaikuttamisesta. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja haluat kehittää itseäsi yrittäjänä. Etsit tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välille.

Kotirinki on kotimainen ketju, joka on tarjonnut palveluita asiakkaiden kotiin jo vuodesta 2002. Ketjussa toimii jo lähes 100 tyytyväistä yrittäjää. Toimimme mikrofranchising-toimintamallilla, eli jokainen palveluntuottajamme on itsenäinen paikallinen pienyrittäjä. Kotirinki-ketjuun liittymisessä et joudu maksamaan kallista liittymismaksua, vaan aloituskustannukset koostuvat työvälineistä ja -vaatteista sekä muista yrityksen perustamiseen liittyvistä kustannuksista.

Testaa vastaammeko me sinun haaveisiisi paremmasta työstä ja sujuvammasta arjesta: Hyppää uudenaikaiseen kotipalvelutyöhön! Käy tekemässä onnellisuustestimme

Nyt on täydellinen hetki hypätä mukaan kasvavaan kotipalvelualaan tukea, asiakkaita ja etuja heti alusta alkaen.

Hae mukaan jo tänään ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä olisit sopiva Kotipalveluyrittäjäksi. Haastattelut käynnistetään jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakemuksen ja infopaketin löydät sivuiltamme.

Tervetuloa nauttimaan siistimmästä arjesta kanssamme. Seuraava koulutus on jo heti syyskuussa!

Avainsanoja: siivous, kotiapu, kotipalvelu, kotisiivous, lisätyö, osa-aikatyö, lisäansio, lisätulo, kotipalvelu, asiakaspalvelu, asiakaspalvelutyö, yrittäjä, yrittäjyys, siivousala, puhtausala, siivooja, lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, kotihoiva, siistijä, kokoaikatyö, hoiva-avustaja, kodinhuoltaja, päivätyö, laitoshuoltaja, puhtausala, hoitoala, kotipalveluala, siivoustyö, avointyöpaikka, toiminimi,

jobs.title: Palvelukotivastaava, Kurjenpolven palvelukoti
jobs.description:
Tule johtamaan arkea, jolla on merkitys.

**Etsimme nyt palvelukotivastaavaa Kurjenpolven palvelukotiin Polvijärvelle.**

Kurjenpolven palvelukoti tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista 12 aikuiselle tukea tarvitsevalle henkilölle, joiden tuen tarpeen taustalla on esimerkiksi kehitysvamma. Meillä jokaisen arki rakentuu osallisuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja oikeudesta elää oman näköistä elämää – meillä koti on koti.

**Tehtäväsi**

Palvelukotivastaavana johdat yksikön toimintaa ja toimit tiimin esihenkilönä. Varmistat, että asukkaiden arki on turvallista, yksilöllistä ja oman näköistä. Pidät huolta siitä, että toiminta on laadukasta, vaikuttavaa ja taloudellisesti kestävää. Olet läsnä palvelukodin arjessa; noin puolet työstäsi on asiakastyötä ja puolet hallinnollista johtamistyötä.

Palvelukotivastaavana olet arjen johtaja ja mahdollistaja: pidät suunnan kirkkaana, mutta teet työtä lähellä ihmisiä ja tiimiä. Arvostamme vuorovaikutustaitoja, rohkeutta tehdä päätöksiä ja halua johtaa työtä niin, että laatu, hyvinvointi ja muutoskyky kulkevat rinnakkain.

Työnkuvaasi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- työvuorosuunnittelu ja työsuhdeasiat kuten rekrytointi ja perehdytys


- omavalvonnan, lääkehoidon ja turvallisuuden toteutumisen varmistaminen


- yksikön talouden suunnittelu ja seuranta


- yhteistyö omaisten, hyvinvointialueiden ja muiden kumppaneiden kanssa


- yksikön toiminnan kehittäminen yhdessä asukkaiden ja tiimin kanssa.


**Odotamme sinulta:**

- Soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa sosiaali- ja terveysalalta (esimerkiksi sosionomi AMK tai sairaanhoitaja AMK), Valvira-rekisteröintiä ja voimassa olevaa sote-ammattikorttia


- Riittävää kokemusta vammaisalasta


- Vahvaa vammaispalvelulain (675/2023) tuntemusta


- Johtamisosaamista opintojen tai työkokemuksen kautta


- Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa ja voimassa olevat lääkeluvat


- Rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä ennen työn aloitusta.


**Miksi valita meidät?**

Honkalampi-säätiö on yhteiskunnallinen yritys, joka mahdollistaa hyvää elämää ihmisille, jotka tarvitsevat tukea arjessaan. Kehitämme palveluja, joissa laatu, osallisuus ja vastuullisuus kulkevat aidosti rinnakkain. Käytämme taloudelliset voittovaramme asiakkaidemme palveluiden kehittämiseen ja yhteiskunnallisten haasteiden ratkaisemiseen.

Honkalammen asumispalveluiden esihenkilötiimi kohtaa toisiaan säännöllisesti ja arjen tuki ja neuvot ovat helposti saatavilla. Honkalammella johtajuus tarkoittaa läsnäoloa ja muutoskykyä – halua kehittää toimintaa niin, että laatu ja hyvinvointi pysyvät tasapainossa. Arvomme, vastuu, rohkeus ja kekseliäisyys, näkyvät arjen teoissa joka päivä.

Hyvinvointiasi tukevat laaja työterveyshuolto, liukuva työaika, osittainen etätyömahdollisuus ja ePassin kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja hyvinvointietu. Palkkaus määräytyy yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:in mukaan kokemuksen ja tehtävän vaativuuden perusteella (palkkaluokka G27 + tehtäväkohtainen palkanosa).

**Lisätiedot ja haku**

Jätäthän hakemuksesi 13.9.2026 mennessä osoitteeseen: rekrytointi@hl-s.fi

**Toimithan nopeasti, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:

Palvelupäällikkö Saila Kosunen

saila.kosunen@hl-s.fi | 0400 377228

_Tule mukaan rakentamaan kanssamme pykälää parempaa arkea. Honkalampi-säätiössä teemme työtä, jotta kenenkään unelmat eivät jäisi olosuhteiden tai tuen puutteen vuoksi toteutumatta. Meillä johtaminen tapahtuu arjessa ja ihmisten keskellä – meillä koti on koti._

_Asumispalveluidemme arkea pääset seuraamaan myös Facebookin ja Instagramin puolella. Löydät meidän tunnisteella_ @honkalampiasumispalvelut

www.honkalampi.fi

Nautit asiakkaiden auttamisesta ja heidän arkeensa vaikuttamisesta. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja haluat kehittää itseäsi yrittäjänä. Etsit tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välille.

Toimimme mikrofranchising-toimintamallilla, eli jokainen palveluntuottajamme on itsenäinen paikallinen pienyrittäjä. Kotirinki-ketjuun liittymisessä et joudu maksamaan kallista liittymismaksua, vaan aloituskustannukset koostuvat työvälineistä ja -vaatteista sekä muista yrityksen perustamiseen liittyvistä kustannuksista.

jobs.title: Chauffør søges til blandet kørsel / Truck Driver – Mixed Transport
jobs.description:
Da vi er i rivende udvikling søger vi derfor nye Medarbejder til vores Transport afd. Vi søger lastbilchauffør til blandet kørsel

Dag Log – Brøndby (Storkøbenhavn)

Er du en stabil, ansvarsbevidst og erfaren lastbilchauffør, som trives med varierende opgaver? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores team hos Dag Log.

Vi søger en lastbilchauffør til blandet kørsel, hvor opgaverne kan variere mellem distributionskørsel, afhentning og levering samt eventuelt længere ture – afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og ønsker.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling med ordnede forhold

  • Varieret kørsel – både lokal og regional (evt. længere ture)

  • Gode kollegaer og uformel, professionel omgangstone

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og gældende overenskomst

  • Fast bil og moderne materiel

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har gyldigt kørekort kategori CE

  • Har gyldigt EU-chaufførbevis og førerkort (tachografkort)

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarlig og serviceminded

  • Taler og forstår dansk (eller engelsk på rimeligt niveau)

  • Har erfaring med lastbilkørsel
    (gerne både distributions- og landevejskørsel)

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og har styr på dokumentation og kørselsregistrering

Arbejdssted

Vores base ligger i Brøndby (Storkøbenhavn).

Ansøgning

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så send din ansøgning og evt. CV til:

Dag-group@outlook.dk

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

----/-/-/-/English/-/-/-/--/--/-/

Truck Driver – Mixed Transport

Dag Log – Brøndby (Greater Copenhagen)

Dag Log is seeking a reliable and professional truck driver for mixed transport operations. The position is a key part of our daily logistics operations, where punctuality, quality, and professional customer interaction are essential.

As a driver at Dag Log, you will handle a variety of transport tasks, including distribution, pickup and delivery, and potentially longer-distance routes, depending on your qualifications and operational needs.

Key responsibilities

  • Execution of planned transport assignments with a strong focus on on-time delivery and high service quality

  • Distribution, pickup, and delivery of goods

  • Ensuring correct documentation and transport records

  • Professional interaction with customers and business partners

  • Compliance with all applicable transport legislation and driving/rest regulations

We offer

  • A full-time position with stable and well-organized employment conditions

  • Varied and independent driving assignments

  • Modern vehicles and equipment, including a dedicated truck

  • A professional working environment with skilled and supportive colleagues

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and applicable collective agreements

We expect that you

  • Hold a valid CE driving license

  • Possess a valid EU Driver Qualification Card and digital tachograph card

  • Are reliable, responsible, and well-structured

  • Have experience with truck driving, preferably both distribution and long-distance transport

  • Can work independently and maintain a high level of professionalism

  • Communicate effectively in English (Danish is an advantage)

  • Have a strong focus on safety, quality, and accurate documentation

Work location

The position is based in Brøndby, Greater Copenhagen.

Application

If you are interested in joining a professional and well-established logistics company, please submit your application and CV to:

Dag-group@outlook.dk
