jobs.title: Työnjohtaja, LVI
jobs.description:
Liity mukaan laivanrakentajien joukkoon – 160 vuotta huippuosaamista Helsingin keskustassa.

Olemme Helsinki Shipyard – telakka, joka on suunnitellut, rakentanut ja toimittanut räätälöityjä, korkealaatuisia matkustaja-aluksia ja jäänmurtajia ääriolosuhteisiin jo vuodesta 1865. Vuonna 2025 juhlistamme 160-vuotista taivaltamme, ja olemme ylpeitä saadessamme jatkaa tarinaamme Helsingin sydämessä, Hietalahden telakalla.

Meillä laivanrakennus tehdään alusta loppuun saman katon alla – suunnittelusta ja rungon valmistuksesta aina varusteluun, sisustukseen ja käyttöönottoon saakka. Tämä tekee meistä ainutlaatuisen työpaikan: näet oman kädenjälkesi osana kokonaisuutta ja pääset seuraamaan, kuinka valtava laiva nousee telakan hallissa vaihe vaiheelta valmiiksi.

Erikoisosaamisemme on arktisissa aluksissa, mutta rakennamme kaikkea superjahdeista monitoimijäänmurtajiin. Itse asiassa olemme valmistaneet noin 50 % maailman jäänmurtajista – ilman meitä jäisillä merillä navigointi olisi huomattavasti vaikeampaa.

Haemme oma-aloitteista LVI-osaajaa työnjohtajaksi telakan kunnossapitotiimiin!

Tässä roolissa pääset keskelle tekemistä – varmistamaan, että tuotanto toimii sujuvasti ja kehittämään kunnossapitoa yhdessä osaavan tiimin kanssa.

Tehtävänkuvaus

Työssäsi vastaat LVI-huoltotöiden suunnittelusta, koordinoinnista ja päivittäisestä johtamisesta. Huolehdit töiden aikataulutuksesta, resurssien organisoinnista ja työturvallisuudesta. Varmistat, että tiimillä on hyvät edellytykset onnistua työssään.

Päävastuut

- LVI-huolto- ja kunnossapitotöiden työnjohto

- Materiaalien ja tarvikkeiden hankinnan koordinointi

- Työn laadun, turvallisuuden ja dokumentoinnin varmistaminen

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutustaustaa, esimerkiksi talotekniikasta

- Aiempaa työkokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta ja kunnossapitojärjestelmistä

- Tuntemusta kiinteistötekniikasta ja kunnossapidosta

- Hyviä organisointi- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Kyky johtaa useita samanaikaisia työtehtäviä

- Oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

Arvostamme erityisesti halua kehittää toimintaa ja rakentaa toimivaa yhteistyötä tiimin kanssa.

Miksi tämä voisi kiinnostaa sinua?

- Näet konkreettisesti työn tuloksen – joka viikko alus etenee silminnähtävästi.

- Teet töitä osaavien ammattilaisten kanssa matalassa organisaatiossa: meillä tehdään töitä porukalla, ei urakalla. Vältämme siiloja ja teemme yhdessä.

- Työ on monipuolista, merkityksellistä ja täynnä oppimismahdollisuuksia.

- Helsingin telakka toimii Helsingin sydämessä ja meidän laivat seilaavat maailman merillä. Täällä yhdistyy suomalainen osaaminen, pitkä historia ja kansainväliset huippuhankkeet.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jätä CV ja avoin hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmäämme 30.8.2026 mennessä. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja aloituksesta sovitaan valittavan henkilön kanssa.

Huomioithan, että hakemukset otetaan vastaan vain rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta GDPR-vaatimusten täyttämiseksi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa kunnossapidon osastopäällikkö Ari Sylve, ari.sylve@helsinkishipyard.fi tai p. 050 5908 8386.

Osana valintaprosessia tehtävään valituille henkilöille tehdään terveystarkastus, joka sisältää myös huumetestin. Joissakin tehtävissä saatetaan lisäksi vaatia turvallisuusselvitys.

jobs.title: Front Desk Salesperson, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Front Desk Salespersons for various Lapland Safaris locations for the winter season 2026-2027. We are looking for Front Desk Salespersons for Levi, Saariselkä and Luosto.**

**_Please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement._**

A Front Desk Salesperson is a true multitasker. As the front of the safari house, you will serve our international and domestic guests. You will help the guests choose the most suitable service for them, make reservations, and handle the process further. The Front Desk service point also handles equipment rentals, the Safari Shop store, as well as pricing and displaying its products. Additionally, your tasks include working at the cash register and assisting guests during safari departures. Front Desk Salespersons work very closely with other teams, such as sales and production.

The work is not only done face-to-face at the customer service point, but part of your work will take place in the back office using various systems. Therefore, we expect good IT skills and proficiency in multiple systems from those selected for the Front Desk role. Back-office tasks include making and managing reservations, responding to messages received from our guests via email and phone, and communicating with stakeholders. A significant part of the work takes place over the phone, so we require readiness for customer service via phone.

Responding to customer feedback and messaging on social media are also often part of the Front Desk job description, but the emphasis of tasks varies by destination and within the season.

Front Desk also assists the Clothing Team in handing the equipment to the guests and in dressing them.

**In Levi,** your work can be face-to-face customer service or independent work in the back office depending on the shift. Work is done in three different shifts.

**In Saariselkä,** the proportion of equipment rental and guidance on their use is significant. In December, you will participate in assisting safari tasks outdoors, and store management is also emphasized.

**In Luosto,** the work is mainly face-to-face at the safari house reception, and daily customer service via phone and email is also part of the job. Safari sales and equipment rental are the main focus. The work is done in two shifts.

**We expect from you:**

- Customer service skills and being sales-oriented

- Initiative and eagerness to learn new things

- Excellent cooperation and social skills

- Problem-solving skills, flexibility and ability to handle pressure

- Accuracy required in handling money and calculating the cash register

- Fluent proficiency in English, other languages, especially French, are considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Support from a top work team and a varied job description

- An international work community

- The beautiful landscapes of Lapland

- An easy way to come to work in Lapland

- Numerous leisure opportunities

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides new employees with paid, role-specific training at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Depending on the destination, the work will begin in October-November and last until the end of February or March-April. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade B-C, hourly wage starting from 12,90 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

jobs.title: Suomen kielen kouluttaja/vastuukouluttaja
jobs.description:
Laptuote-säätiö hakee vastuukouluttajaa Etelä-Karjalan työllisyysalueelle suunniteltuun toiminnalliseen suomen kielen kotoutumiskoulutukseen. Koulutus on tarkoitettu erityisesti osallistujille, joiden suomen kielen taito on pääsääntöisesti tasolla A1.1–A1.3 ja jotka hyötyvät hitaammin etenevästä, käytännönläheisestä ja vahvasti tuetusta opetuksesta. Tehtävä täytetään, mikäli Laptuote-säätiö valitaan palveluntuottajaksi.

Vastuukouluttajana vastaat suomen kielen opetuksesta, koulutuksen toteutuksesta, etenemisen seurannasta ja osallistujien ohjauksesta. Määrittelet toiminnallisen oppimisen kielelliset tavoitteet ja työvalmentajat toimivat omissa oppimisympäristöissään toiminnallisen oppimisen ohjaajina. Oppimisympäristöinä ovat Goodwill-kierrätysmyymälä ja tuotanto, pesula, keittiö- ja siivouspaja, puupaja, mediapaja sekä sote-paja.

**Keskeiset työtehtävät:**

\- suomen kielen opetuksen suunnittelu ja toteutus OPH-649-2022-perusteiden mukaisesti (A1.1–A1.3 taso)

\- toiminnallisen oppimisen kielellisten tavoitteiden määrittely ja työpajajaksojen pedagoginen koordinointi;

\- osallistujien oppimisen seuranta;

\- osallistujien henkilökohtainen ohjaus, opiskelumotivaation tukeminen, jatkopolkujen suunnittelu ja kirjallisen loppupalautteen laatiminen;

\- kehitetystä asiakkaan jatkosuunnitelmasta ja siihen liittyvistä konkreettisista jatkotoimenpiteistä

\- yhteistyö tilaajan, työpajojen työvalmentajien ja muun tarvittavan verkoston kanssa.

\- koulutuksen päätyttyä kouluttajan tulee antaa asiakaskohtainen kirjallinen palaute asiakkaan kielitaidosta ja koulutuksen aikana

Lisätietoja toiminnastamme: www.laptuote.fi.

jobs.title: Senior Ecologist
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Do you enjoy balancing technical fieldwork with meaningful ecological impact? Are you ready to lead surveys, mentor early-career colleagues, and deliver high-quality reports? Are you looking for a role that offers variety, autonomy, and the chance to shape your ecological career? We’re looking for a Senior Ecologist to join Woodrow (part of the APEM Group) in Ireland. This is an exciting opportunity to take the next step in your consultancy career—delivering high-quality ecological assessments, leading fieldwork across diverse Irish habitats, and contributing to nationally significant environmental projects. You will work with other ecology professionals in our office in Sligo. Around 50% of your time will involve fieldwork, including travel across Ireland (and occasionally Northern Ireland or the UK), so confidence working in dynamic, outdoor settings is key. As a Senior Ecologist, you’ll lead survey programmes, deliver technical reports (e.g. EcIA, AA Screening, NIS, EIAR), manage small to mid-sized projects, and guide junior ecologists. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to tender writing, service development, and cross-disciplinary collaboration with experts across the wider APEM Group. To be successful in this role, you’ll need: A third-level qualification in Ecology, Environmental Science, Zoology, Botany, or a related field 3–5+ years of experience in ecological consultancy or similar Strong field survey skills and working knowledge of Irish flora and fauna Experience producing ecological impact assessments and technical reports aligned with Irish planning law A good understanding of Irish and EU legislation (Habitats Directive, Birds Directive, Planning and Development Act) Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal Ability to manage projects independently, including budgets, schedules, and client relationships A full clean EU driving licence and willingness to travel for fieldwork Bonus points for: CIEEM Associate Membership (or eligibility), and interest in progressing toward Full Membership or Chartership Experience managing field teams and mentoring junior staff Familiarity with GIS tools (QGIS, ArcGIS) First Aid or remote fieldwork safety training (training can be provided) You will be offered the chance to work on a variety of projects, many of our employees have worked on projects that have been of personal interest to them. We match this with a commitment to continuous development and learning to support your career. We also offer benefits to look after you, from private medical insurance for all employees, access to mental health first aiders and comprehensive income protection if you cannot work. We also offer superb flexible working options, balancing work with your life.

jobs.title: Vi udvider og søger 3 stærke B2B-sælgere – opstart hurtigst muligt!
jobs.description:
Vi udvider og søger 3 stærke B2B-sælgere – opstart hurtigst muligt!

3 x Salgskonsulenter til Proff.dk – Verv ApS (Århus C)

  • En fast garantiløn på 115 kr. i timen og provision

Vi har rygende travlt og skruer op for væksten! Derfor udvider vi salgsteamet og skal bruge 3 nye knivskarpe kolleger, der er klar til at smøge ærmerne op og rykke ind på kontoret med det samme.

Er du resultatorienteret, og vil du repræsentere et af Danmarks mest anerkendte erhvervsbrands? Hos Verv ApS leder vi efter dig, der brænder for B2B-salg og vil være med til at drive salget af Proff.dk – Danmarks førende portal til erhvervs- og virksomhedsinformation.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Stærk lønpakke: En fast garantiløn på 115 kr. i timen og provisionsordning på 45 % uden loft. Din indsats og dine resultater afspejler sig direkte på lønsedlen.

  • Et brand, der åbner døre: Du skal sælge et velkendt produkt. Beslutningstagerne kender allerede Proff.dk, hvilket giver dig høj troværdighed fra første sekund i røret.

  • Professionelle rammer: Du bliver en del af et dedikeret team i Tilst med fokus på tæt sparring, salgstræning og fælles succes. Vi løfter i flok og fejrer resultaterne sammen!

Hvem er du?

Om du har flere års erfaring med B2B-salg, eller om du har et medfødt salgstalent og det rette drive, er ikke afgørende – det vigtigste er din indstilling.

  • Du trives med opsøgende salg og kan skabe tillid hos beslutningstagere.

  • Du arbejder struktureret, er en stærk teamplayer og motiveres af klare mål.

  • Du vil være en del af et ambitiøst forretningsmiljø (læs mere om os på www.verv.dk).

Drop den lange ansøgning – grib telefonen!

Vi ved, at de bedste sælgere er bedst i direkte dialog. Derfor overflødiggør vi den traditionelle, lange ansøgning. Da vi skal bruge 3 nye sælgere med opstart hurtigst muligt, afholder vi samtaler løbende.

jobs.title: To lønkonsulenter til lønadministrationen i Albertslund Kommune
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde i en kommune med store ambitioner, engagerede medarbejdere og en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer? Så søger vi to nye kollegaer til vores lønteam, der kan arbejde selvstændigt og lide at have indflydelse på løsningen af egne opgaver, men samtidig er en holdspiller, der brænder for den organisation, du bliver en del af. 

Om Albertslund Kommune

Albertslund er en grøn kommune med store ambitioner. Vi er stolte af vores kommune, og gør os umage i vores opgaver og indsatser for borgerne, foreningerne og virksomhederne. Vi er én kommune og én organisation. Vi har engagerede og dygtige medarbejdere samt en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer. Det gør Albertslund Kommune til et godt sted at arbejde. 

Om enheden HR & Løn i Albertslund Kommune
Lønadministrationen er et nyt team, der pr. 1. januar 2026 blev udvidet til at bestå af 7 lønkonsulenter og en faglig koordinator. Dette skete ifm. en centralisering af lønadministrationen. Pt. er de 5 stillinger som lønkonsulenter besat og stillingen som faglig koordinator, så derfor har vi to ledige stillinger som lønkonsulenter hos os. Formålet med centraliseringen er at skabe en professionel lønfunktion og dermed få en driftssikker og bæredygtig lønfunktion på den lange bane. Udover lønteamet er der et team på 3 medarbejdere og en studentermedhjælper, der arbejder med personalejura og 3 kolleger, som arbejder med arbejdsmiljø, MED og udviklingsopgaver. Vores primære rolle er at yde faglig bistand og rådgivning til hele organisationen, både det politiske og administrative niveau, omkring personalejura, HR og løn. Du bliver en del af et stærkt hold. Ambitionerne og det faglige niveau er højt, stemningen er god og man "vil hinanden". Vi tager alle ansvar for opgaverne og anvender digitale værktøjer så meget som muligt.

Om stillingen
Vi drømmer om at få to nye kollegaer, der har vilje, lyst og evne til at arbejde med lønadministration Det er vigtigt for os, at du er nysgerrig, initiativrig og har eller ønsker at få en bred viden om løn- og ansættelsesvilkår inden for det kommunale område. Det er vigtigt, at du har en opsøgende og struktureret tilgang i dit arbejde. Vi bruger KMD Opus. Du vil komme til at håndtere alle personalegrupper, samt alle typer af ansættelser på tværs af kommunen, ligesom du meget gerne må have talforståelse. Du skal derfor have lyst til og interesse for en hverdag med stor bredde i opgaverne. Er dette ikke muligt fra starten, så arbejder vi os derhen sammen.

Stillingen har fokus på klassisk lønadministration. Opgaverne i denne stilling består primært i lønsagsbehandling af forskellig art, såsom:

  • Generel personaleadministration, udfærdigelse af ansættelsesbrev, anciennitetsberegninger for løn og pension, timetalsændring, lønsammensætning, fratrædelse m.v.
  • Rådgivning og vejledning til ledere, administrative medarbejder, lønmodtager og øvrige samarbejdspartner i relation til alle spørgsmål vedrørende løn, ansættelsesvilkår, arbejdstid, barsel, sygdom, refusion og ferieregler m.m.
  • Lønindplacering
  • Overenskomstfortolkning
  • Ansøgning om og behandling af diverse refusioner (dagpenge, flexjob, barsel og AKUT) 
  • Ændringer i E-indkomst og SKAT
  • Afstemninger af lønkonti
  • Håndtering af spørgsmål til KMD Opus
  • Udarbejdelse af skriftlige oplæg/retningslinjer om lønområdet
  • Arbejde med digitalisering/automatisering af processerne omkring løn

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med lønadministration, men det er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har mod på og lyst til de beskrevne opgaver. 

Dagene er aldrig ens, men der vil dog være en række tilbagevendende opgaver. 

Vi forventer, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, og tager ansvar for opgaverne på lige fod med dine kollegaer. Du bliver en del af et team og en enhed, der vægter samarbejdet og relationerne højt, har det sjovt med hinanden, og som vil gøre sig umage for, at du kan føle dig hjemme. Du skal trives med månedlige deadlines, og være god til at kunne prioritere både egne såvel som teamets fælles opgaver, for at alle når i mål.

Vi kan tilbyde

  • et spændende og udfordrende job i en bæredygtig by for børnene, det grønne og fællesskabet
  • nogle fantastiske kollegaer, som venter på at byde dig velkommen og glæder sig til samarbejdet med dig
  • deltagelse i udvidelsen af en lønadministration, der skal professionaliseres
  • stor bredde i opgaverne
  • gode muligheder for at præge jobindholdet og sætte dine kompetencer i spil 
  • fleksibel arbejdstid med mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage.

Ansøgning og tiltrædelse

Stillingerne er faste på 37 timer på overenskomstvilkår med start 1. november 2026. Lønindplacering sker efter forhandling mellem kommunen og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Det er en del af Albertslund Kommunes ansættelsespolitik at fremme mangfoldighed og ligestilling. 

Det er en forudsætning for din ansættelse i Albertslund Kommune, at du har en gyldig arbejds- og opholdstilladelse. 

Albertslund Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Der er ansøgningsfrist onsdag den 31. august 2026. Der kan indgå en case i en evt. 2. samtale. 

Du kan blive klogere på Albertslund som by og arbejdsplads på www.albertslund.dk

Du er velkommen til at kontakte leder af HR & Løn, Maria Sauer på tlf. 20 49 96 75, eller faglig koordinator for lønadministrationen Elena Høgskær på telefon 60 56 24 09, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Velkommen til Albertslund - den bæredygtige by for børnene, det grønne og fællesskaber. Albertslund Kommune har mange kvaliteter, som skaber fantastiske rammer for hverdagslivet – både for borgere og medarbejdere. Midt i naturen og med et rigt forenings- og kulturliv, som børn og voksne cykler til og fra på byens mange kilometer cykelstier, der er adskilt fra bilerne på vejene. Der er S-tog lige til døren og flere supercykelstier, bl.a. mellem Albertslund og Vesterport i hjertet af København. Desuden skaber letbanen gode forbindelser til hele hovedstadsområdet. 

I Albertslund Kommune har vi samme tilgang til vores opgaver, som vi selv ville ønske at opleve som borgere. Vi er vidt forskellige, men er fælles om vores opgave for borgere, foreninger og virksomheder. Du kan møde nogle af vores dygtige medarbejdere på www.albertslund.dk/indefra og få et indtryk af bredden af arbejdsområder, opgaver og fagligheder i Albertslund Kommune. 

I Albertslund Kommune er der højt til loftet og gode udviklingsmuligheder - vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Oletko sinä uusi Safrentlainen?

Me etsimme juuri sinua! Välitämme töitä ja tekijöitä isolla sydämellä.

Etsimme kahta sähköasentajaa asiakkaallemme Turun seudulle!

Oletko sähköalan ammattilainen tai urasi alkuvaiheessa oleva tekijä, joka kaipaa pitkäaikaista työtä? Haemme nyt sähköasentajaa asiakkaallemme monipuolisiin sähköalan tehtäviin.

Työnkuva

Työ sisältää esimerkiksi:

* kaapelointeja ja kytkentöjä
* sähköjärjestelmien asennus- ja huoltotöitä
* työskentelyä itsenäisesti sekä osana työryhmää

Työssä pääset tekemään monipuolisia tehtäviä ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

* sähköalan koulutusta
* oma-aloitteista ja reipasta työotetta
* huolellisuutta ja vastuullisuutta
* hyvää fyysistä toimintakykyä

* voimassa olevat ammattikortit katsotaan eduksi

Myös uransa alussa olevat sähköasentajat ovat tervetulleita hakemaan! Tärkeintä on motivaatio ja halu oppia.

Palkkaus: Rakennusalan TES kokemuksesi ja tehtävän mukaan.

Työt alkavat heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Jos kiinnostuit tehtävästä, lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian sähköisen hakulomakkeemme kautta – käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana.

PhD Research Fellow in Machine Learning for Cognitive Neuroscience
jobs.description:
About the position

Position as PhD Research Fellow in Machine Learning and Applied Cognitive Neuroscience available at the Department of Informatics.

The fellowship period is three years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended either for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance up top four years. 

Starting date no later than December 31, 2026.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The position is placed in the Digital Signal Processing and Image Analysis group (DSB), Section for Machine Learning, Department of Informatics at the University of Oslo. The DSB research group has seven full-time and five adjunct positions. We perform research over a wide range of applications in image analysis and machine learning, as well as in digital signal processing and acoustic imaging. There are about 20 Postdocs and PhD research fellows in the group with financing from a variety of national and international funding agencies, as well as from industry.


Job description

We are seeking an ambitious candidate to develop Machine Learning models and frameworks for time series analysis, aimed at understanding how the human brain encodes information.

This cross-disciplinary project is a high-level collaboration between the Digital Signal Processing Group (DSB), at the Section for Machine Learning (IFI), and the Group for Cognitive Neurophysiology (Medical Faculty). The team has research links with Bradley Voytek at the Halıcıoğlu Data Science Institute (University of California San Diego, USA). By bridging experimental neurophysiology with advanced algorithmic design, we aim to significantly enhance the understanding of high-dimensional neural activity patterns.

The successful candidate will work with open available datasets obtained in rodents and unique datasets of neural activity. Your primary focus will be to design new learning frameworks and neural network architectures to advance our fundamental understanding of how the human brain forms perception and memories.  In detail, you will use transformer architectures to analyze time series of local field potentials recorded in rodents and compare performance to time series of action potentials recorded in the same animals (the state of the art); apply and interpret the architecture to local field potential data recorded in humans who have seen a vast number of images from the CoCo-database (https://cocodataset.org); and apply and interpret the architecture to local field potential data recorded in humans who have seen movies.

The data for the project is already collected and available. Project leaders are Adin Ramirez Rivera (DSB, IFI) and Jørgen Sugar (Medical Faculty).


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master's degree or equivalent in computer science, physics, applied mathematics, electrical engineering, cybernetics, data science, computational science, neuroscience or related fields
  • For applicants with a foreign completed degree (master level), it must be equiva-lent to a master in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented proficiency in scientific programming (e.g., Python)
  • Documented proficiency in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch)
  • Documented background in machine learning, mathematics, linear algebra, and statistics
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with transformer models and attention mechanisms
  • Strong background in probabilistic machine learning
  • Proven track record in time-series analysis and modeling, signal processing, medical domain, and/or related fields
  • Strong writing skills

Candidates without a master’s degree have until September 30, 2026 to complete the final exam.

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see:
http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/

All candidates and projects will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precisely and in a structured manner, while adapting to new tasks
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and ability to handle hectic periods
  • You are a person who prefers being present at work and actively contributes to the professional and social environment you are a part of

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
ETSIMME PUDASJÄRVELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON

Kotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Etsimme nyt Pudasjärven alueelle lähihoitajaa kotihoitoon vakituiseen tai osa-aikaiseen, toistaiseksi voimassaolevaan työhön.

MITÄ KOTIHOIDON TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Perushoito ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn ja hyvinvoinnin tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa osaamistasi

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Porvoo
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,56-14,91 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

jobs.title: Chef de Partie
jobs.description:

Job Description Thindi Phibsborough is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic Chef de Partie to join our dynamic kitchen team on a full-time, permanent basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing a designated section of the kitchen, preparing and presenting high-quality dishes, maintaining exceptional food safety and hygiene standards, and supporting the efficient day-to-day operation of the kitchen. The role requires strong culinary expertise, excellent organisational abilities, and the ability to perform consistently in a fast-paced hospitality environment while delivering outstanding food quality and customer satisfaction. Key Duties and Responsibilities Manage and oversee an assigned kitchen section, ensuring smooth and efficient service throughout each shift. Prepare, cook, and present a wide range of dishes in accordance with established recipes, quality standards, and presentation guidelines. Organise daily mise en place to ensure all ingredients and equipment are prepared before service. Monitor food quality, consistency, portion control, and presentation to maintain company standards. Ensure full compliance with HACCP procedures, food safety legislation, hygiene regulations, and allergen management requirements. Assist in menu preparation and contribute ideas for seasonal dishes and special menu offerings. Monitor stock levels, conduct stock rotation using FIFO principles, and minimise food waste through effective inventory management. Assist with ordering food supplies, checking deliveries, and ensuring all ingredients are stored correctly. Supervise, train, and support junior chefs and kitchen assistants to promote teamwork and maintain operational standards. Maintain a clean, organised, and safe kitchen environment, ensuring all workstations and equipment are sanitised at all times. Collaborate closely with the Head Chef and kitchen management team to improve kitchen efficiency and maintain excellent service standards. Ensure compliance with all company policies, health and safety legislation, and standard operating procedures. Candidate Requirements Essential Relevant qualification in Culinary Arts, Professional Cookery, Hospitality, or equivalent practical experience. A minimum of two years' professional chef experience in a commercial kitchen environment is essential. Previous experience as a Chef de Partie, Chef, or Assistant Chef in a busy restaurant or hospitality environment. Strong knowledge of food preparation techniques, kitchen operations, and commercial cooking methods. Excellent understanding of HACCP principles, food safety regulations, hygiene standards, and allergen management. Experience with stock control, inventory management, food ordering, and waste reduction. Ability to supervise junior kitchen staff and maintain high standards during busy service periods. Strong organizational, communication, and time management skills.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Arctic Humanities, Arctic infrastructure studies and GIS
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

A three-year Postdoctoral Research Fellow position is available at the School of Business and Economics (Handelshøgskolen), UiT The Arctic University of Norway, starting 1 March 2027. 

The position is affiliated with the Research Council of Norway Groundbreaking research funded project ROADS – The Roads That Remain: Residual Pathways as Living Archives in Northern Fennoscandia (2026-2030), led by Dr. Tarja Salmela. 

We are seeking a researcher with expertise in GIS, spatial analysis, and critical approaches to mapping and infrastructure, and interest towards collaborative, experimental, and community-oriented research methods. The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and internationally oriented research team investigating how roads and pathways continue to shape Northern landscapes long after their official purpose has faded, alongside pathways that are less visible in the landscape yet continue to endure through local knowledge, ongoing practices of movement, and memory. 

The appointment is for a period of three years, ending 28 February 2030. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

Working and living in Tromsø 

Tromsø/Romssa serves as an important hub for research, culture, governance, and mobility in the region of Northern Norway and Sápmi. Its position as a regional gateway between coastal, inland, and cross-border northern landscapes makes it a particularly meaningful base for ROADS. 

The School of Business and Economics at UiT hosts a growing community of scholars working on sustainability, governance, mobilities, Arctic transformations, and societal change. The successful candidate will become part of a dynamic interdisciplinary environment, including UiT’s Environmental Humanities thematic network that ROADS is closely connected to.


The project/position's field of research

The project 

ROADS offers the first systematic study of residual road infrastructures in Northern Fennoscandia—roads and pathways that have fallen out of official purpose but continue to shape landscapes, memories, and mobility practices across the region. These include bypassed roads, abandoned transport corridors, former military and extractive infrastructures, and old roads and seasonal pathways embedded within local and Sámi land-use traditions.

While many remain visible in the landscape, their histories increasingly persist through local knowledge systems that risk disappearing as generations pass. Rather than approaching such infrastructures as obsolete remnants, ROADS conceptualizes them as living archives: material traces through which memory, power, mobility, resistance, and future possibilities continue to unfold.

Drawing on feminist and decolonial Science and Technology Studies, critical infrastructure studies, political ecology, environmental humanities and Indigenous ontologies, ROADS seeks to broaden conventional understandings of infrastructure by integrating relational, seasonal, and more-than human mobility systems into analyses of northern landscapes.

The project combines GIS-based spatial analysis, archival research, ethnography, repeat photography and artistic methods, and collaborative countermapping. It is grounded in close collaboration with local and Sámi communities and culminates in community-responsive public outputs, including a multilingual digital storymap and participatory mapping platform.

While GIS and spatial analysis provide important analytical foundations, ROADS combines these approaches with ethnographic, archival, visual, and artistic methods. The project therefore welcomes applicants interested in methodological experimentation and interdisciplinary research across the social sciences, humanities, environmental sciences, and arts.

The postdoctoral project and responsibilities

The Postdoctoral Research Fellow will play a central role in the project and contribute to both its analytical and public-facing outputs. 

The postdoctoral researcher will lead the spatial and archival components of Work Package 1: Tracing the temporal lives of residual and rendered invisible infrastructures and contribute to synthesis and engagement activities in Work Package 3: Reimagining residual road infrastructures and mobilities in Northern Fennoscandia.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Conducting GIS-based spatial analysis of residual road infrastructures across Northern Fennoscandia.
  • Integrating historical maps, infrastructure records, aerial imagery, and satellite data to identify and visualize infrastructural change over time.
  • Developing innovative approaches to critical spatial visualization and mapping that foreground questions of memory, erasure, survivance, and infrastructural power.
  • Contributing to archival research and the interpretation of historical infrastructure records. 
  • Participating in ethnographic fieldwork, collaborative mapping activities, repeat photography, and visual documentation initiatives alongside the Principal Investigator.
  • Co-leading participatory countermapping workshops and contributing to the development of a multilingual digital storymap and other public facing outputs.
  • Publishing research findings in leading international journals and contributing to conferences, outreach activities, and project dissemination. 

The position offers an opportunity to engage with northern landscapes and communities across Northern Fennoscandia in a place-sensitive way. Fieldwork will take place in active collaboration with local and Sámi knowledge holders and cultural institutions. The postdoctoral researcher will contribute to research that is attentive to the diverse histories, experiences, and knowledge systems that shape northern mobility landscapes.

The postdoctoral researcher will work closely with the Principal Investigator while also developing an independent research profile within the broader framework of the project.


Project description requirements

Applicants are asked to submit a project description (3–5 pages) outlining how they would approach the responsibilities of the postdoctoral position outlined above, within ROADS. The description should demonstrate the applicant's understanding of the project's aims and explain how they would contribute to the spatial, archival, and interdisciplinary dimensions of the research. The description must include a progress plan. 

Applicants are encouraged to reflect on relevant theoretical perspectives, methodological approaches, and analytical strategies, including the use of GIS, spatial analysis, historical sources, participatory mapping, and interdisciplinary collaboration where appropriate. The description should also indicate how the applicant's expertise and research interests would contribute to the project's broader objectives while supporting the development of an independent research profile within the ROADS framework.


Contact

For further information about the position, please contact:

Dr. Tarja Salmela, Principal Investigator, ROADS
email: tarja.t.salmela@uit.no  
School of Business and Economics, BFE 
UiT The Arctic University of Norway


Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • A PhD or equivalent degree in geography, GIScience, human geography, spatial humanities, environmental humanities, infrastructure studies, archaeology, heritage studies, Indigenous studies, anthropology, planning, landscape studies, digital humanities, or another relevant discipline. If you’re at the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply if you have submitted your PhD thesis for doctoral degree evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis with your application. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.
  • Expertise in GIS and spatial analysis.
  • Experience working with spatial datasets, historical maps, remote sensing data, or related geospatial materials. 
  • Strong academic publication record relative to career stage. 
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English. Nordic applicants can document their capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing actively to collaborative research environments.

Desired qualifications: 

  • Skills in Norwegian, Swedish, Finnish, or a Sámi language are considered an asset. We also value applicants who are motivated to develop language skills relevant to the project's geographical and cultural contexts.
  • Experience with critical GIS, participatory mapping, countermapping, or spatial humanities approaches.
  • Knowledge of Arctic, Northern, Indigenous, environmental, infrastructure, mobility, landscape, or heritage research.
  • Experience integrating qualitative and quantitative spatial methods.
  • Skills in visual storytelling, cartographic design, digital heritage, digital humanities, or multimedia research dissemination. 
  • Experience conducting archival research and working with historical sources. 
  • Interest in interdisciplinary and creative research methods, including visual, arts-based, or experimental approaches to landscape and infrastructure research. 
  • Experience working across disciplinary boundaries and integrating spatial, archival, ethnographic, visual, or participatory methods.
  • Familiarity with community-based research, collaborative knowledge production, and Indigenous methodologies

ROADS is grounded in long-term collaboration with local and Sámi communities and engages critically with Indigenous knowledge systems and questions of self-determination and cultural heritage. Sámi scholars and other Indigenous scholars, as well as applicants with relevant experience working in Indigenous research contexts, are particularly encouraged to apply. We also encourage applications from researchers whose experiences and perspectives can contribute to the project's commitment to plurality, community engagement, and inclusive knowledge production.

In the assessment the main emphasis will be attached to the submitted works and the project proposal for the qualifying work. Emphasis shall also be attached to experience from popularization/dissemination and academic policy and administrative activity.

During the assessment emphasis will be put on the candidate’s motivation, potential for research, and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good collaboration skills
  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Wants to contribute to a good working environment

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 


We offer

The successful candidate will join an internationally connected and intellectually vibrant research environment at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Handelshøgskolen, and the thematic network of Environmental Humanities at UiT. The successful candidate will become part of an innovative research project addressing pressing questions concerning infrastructure, mobility, cultural heritage, and environmental change in the Arctic.

The position offers:

  • The opportunity to contribute to a research project with strong academic and societal relevance.
  • Close collaboration with researchers working across Arctic studies, mobility studies, infrastructure studies, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, heritage research, and critical geography.
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation, publication, and career development.
  • Access to GIS and research infrastructure through UiT.
  • Significant opportunities to develop a strong academic research profile.
  • Good career opportunities 
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 


Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Letter of motivation
  • Project proposal (3–5 pages)
  • Academic CV
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • Documentation of educational competence, if available
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important
  • Publication list
  • Academic works, up to ten. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work.

If you’re at the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply if you have submitted your PhD thesis for doctoral degree evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis with your application. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position.


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 630 000 to 720 000 (in a 100% position). (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.) A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

UiT wishes to promote gender equality. If two or more applicants are found to be equally qualified, the university will rank applicants from the underrepresented gender ahead of others.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

jobs.title: PhD Fellow in Arctic Mobility, Landscape and Spatial Justice
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

At The School of Business and Economics at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, ROADS is seeking a highly motivated doctoral researcher interested in questions of mobility, infrastructure, northern landscapes, environmental change, and spatial justice in the Arctic. The successful applicant will become part of an interdisciplinary research team combining geography, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, critical infrastructure studies, heritage research, and spatial analysis. The PhD position is funded for three years, starting 1 March 2027 and ending 28 February 2030, and is embedded within an international and collaborative research environment.

The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to the PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

Working and living in Tromsø 

Tromsø/Romssa serves as an important hub for research, culture, governance, and mobility in the region of Northern Norway and Sápmi. Its position as a regional gateway between coastal, inland, and cross-border northern landscapes makes it a particularly meaningful base for ROADS. The School of Business and Economics at UiT hosts a growing community of scholars working on sustainability, governance, mobilities, Arctic transformations, and societal change. The successful candidate will become part of a dynamic interdisciplinary environment, including UiT’s Environmental Humanities thematic network that ROADS is closely connected to. 


The project

ROADS offers the first systematic study of residual road infrastructures in Northern Fennoscandia—roads and pathways that have fallen out of official purpose but continue to shape landscapes, memories, and mobility practices across the region. These include bypassed roads, abandoned transport corridors, former military and extractive infrastructures, and old roads and seasonal pathways embedded within local and Sámi land-use traditions.

While many remain visible in the landscape, their histories increasingly persist through local knowledge systems that risk disappearing as generations pass. Rather than approaching such infrastructures as obsolete remnants, ROADS conceptualizes them as living archives: material traces through which memory, power, mobility, resistance, and future possibilities continue to unfold.

Drawing on feminist and decolonial Science and Technology Studies, critical infrastructure studies, political ecology, environmental humanities and Indigenous ontologies, ROADS seeks to broaden conventional understandings of infrastructure by integrating relational, seasonal, and more-than human mobility systems into analyses of northern landscapes.

The project combines GIS-based spatial analysis, archival research, ethnography, repeat photography and artistic methods, and collaborative countermapping. It is grounded in close collaboration with local and Sámi communities and culminates in community-responsive public outputs, including a multilingual digital storymap and participatory mapping platform.

While GIS and spatial analysis provide important analytical foundations, ROADS combines these approaches with ethnographic, archival, visual, and artistic methods. The project therefore welcomes applicants interested in methodological experimentation and interdisciplinary research across the social sciences, humanities, environmental sciences, and arts. 


The PhD project, responsibilities and research methods

The PhD project and responsibilities

The successful candidate will undertake doctoral research mainly within Work Package 2: Mapping Conflict and Relational Mobility in the North. The PhD candidate will take a leading role in the WP and receive close supervision from the Principal Investigator while collaborating with the project's postdoctoral researcher and the project network.

The PhD project explores how contemporary road development in Northern Fennoscandia—including infrastructure connected to resource extraction, military activities, and regional development—interacts with older roads, seasonal pathways, and Indigenous and local mobility systems. Rather than treating infrastructure as fixed physical objects, the PhD project investigates roads as dynamic political, cultural, and material assemblages that shape relationships between people, landscapes, governance, and more-than-human worlds. 

Particular attention is given to questions such as: 

  • How do expanding road infrastructures interact with Indigenous and local land use, seasonal mobilities, and relational understandings of landscape? 
  • How are access, mobility, and territorial authority negotiated between different actors, including local communities, Sámi reindeer herders, planners, governmental agencies, and extractive industries?
  • How do roads simultaneously enable, constrain, and transform relationships between people and northern landscapes?

The PhD candidate will have the opportunity to shape the detailed direction of the dissertation within the broader aims of the project. 

Research methods

The project combines: 

  • Archival research
  • GIS and spatial analysis
  • Participatory and critical mapping
  • Ethnographic fieldwork
  • Walking interviews
  • Policy analysis
  • Visual and spatial storytelling 

GIS analysis forms an important component of the project, but it is integrated with qualitative, participatory, and community-engaged approaches. The project therefore welcomes applicants interested in combining spatial analysis with ethnographic and critical social science methods. Fieldwork will involve collaboration with local residents, Sámi communities, municipal planners, land users, and other stakeholders across Northern Fennoscandia.

Applicants are required to submit a project description (3–5 pages, literature references included) outlining how they would approach the proposed doctoral research within Work Package 2 of ROADS. The project description should demonstrate the applicant's understanding of the aims of ROADS and discuss how they would investigate questions related to infrastructure, mobility, landscape, territorial governance, and Indigenous and local land use in Northern Fennoscandia.

While the dissertation is situated within Work Package 2, applicants are encouraged to develop their own research focus within the overall objectives of the project. The final project description will be developed in cooperation with the supervisor. 

The description should reflect on relevant theoretical perspectives and methodological approaches appropriate for doctoral research. Applicants are encouraged to discuss how methods such as GIS and spatial analysis, participatory and critical mapping, ethnographic fieldwork, archival and policy analysis, visual methods, and interdisciplinary collaboration could contribute to their proposed research. The proposal does not need to include all of these approaches but should demonstrate thoughtful consideration of the methods most appropriate for the applicant's intended doctoral project. Applicants should also indicate how their academic background, research interests, and methodological competencies would contribute to the interdisciplinary research environment of ROADS while supporting the development of an original doctoral dissertation. 


Contact

For further information about the position and the ROADS project, please contact: 

Dr. Tarja Salmela, Principal Investigator, ROADS
School of Business and Economics, BFE UiT The Arctic University of Norway

Email: tarja.t.salmela@uit.no 


Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • Applicants must hold a Master's degree equivalent to a Norwegian Master's degree in geography, human geography, Indigenous studies, environmental humanities, archaeology, anthropology, planning, GIScience, landscape studies, political ecology, heritage studies, environmental studies, digital humanities, or another relevant discipline. Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. You may still apply if you are in the final stages of the master’s degree, but the master’s thesis must be submitted for evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis and transcripts of grades for the master's degree with your application. 
  • Strong academic performance and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma. 
  • Demonstrated interest in Arctic, Indigenous, environmental, mobility, infrastructure, or landscape research. 
  • Ability to work independently while contributing actively to collaborative research.

Desired qualifications: 

  • Archival or historical research.
  • GIS and spatial analysis. 
  • Critical GIS, participatory mapping, or countermapping. 
  • Qualitative or ethnographic research. • Indigenous methodologies and community-based research. 
  • Political ecology, infrastructure studies, environmental humanities, or mobility studies. 
  • Visual methods, digital storytelling, or creative and arts-based research.
  • Skills in Norwegian, Swedish, Finnish, or a Sámi language

We also value applicants who are motivated to develop language skills relevant to the project's geographical and cultural contexts. Applicants with backgrounds in geography, archaeology, digital heritage, landscape studies, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, anthropology, planning, and related disciplines are particularly encouraged to apply. ROADS is grounded in long-term collaboration with local and Sámi communities and engages critically with Indigenous knowledge systems and questions of self-determination and cultural heritage. We encourage applications from researchers whose experiences and perspectives can contribute to the project's commitment to plurality, community engagement, and inclusive knowledge production.

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. The project description will also be considered. In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

We will also emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position. We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have good collaboration skills
  • Have good communication and interaction with colleagues and students
  • Wants to contribute to a good working environment

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.


Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

Grade requirements applies both to the master thesis as well as courses part of the master’s degree. The minimum requirements are grade B or better on the master’s degree, and an average grade of B or better on courses that are part of the master’s degree. For integrated master's degrees, applicants are required to have achieved a grade of B or higher on their master's thesis and an overall average grade of C or higher across all courses comprising the integrated degree programme. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.  

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.


Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an internationally connected and intellectually vibrant research environment at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Handelshøgskolen, and the thematic network of Environmental Humanities at UiT. The successful candidate will become part of an innovative research project addressing pressing questions concerning infrastructure, mobility, cultural heritage, and environmental change in the Arctic.

  • The opportunity to contribute to a research project with strong academic and societal relevance
  • Close collaboration with researchers working across Arctic studies, mobility studies, infrastructure studies, environmental humanities, Indigenous studies, heritage research, and critical geography
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation, publication, and career development
  • Access to GIS and research infrastructure through UiT
  • Good career opportunities 
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • The remuneration for the position is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 580 000 to 600 000 (in a 100% position), with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests
  • Academic CV
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Documentation of proficiency in Norwegian (or a Scandinavian language) (if available)
  • References with contact information
  • Master’s thesis, and any other academic works
  • Publication list (if available)
  • Project description (3-5 pages)

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. You may still apply if you are in the final stages of the master’s degree, but the master’s thesis must be submitted for evaluation within the application deadline. You must submit the thesis and transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 


General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

jobs.title: Project & Business Coordinator
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?  

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 

  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 

  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 

  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 

  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 

  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 

  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 

  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 

  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 

  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 

  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 

  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 

  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 

  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 

  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 

  • An understanding of risk management and governance 

  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 

  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 

  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis? 

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.
