Benefits of working for Your Partner ApS

At Your Partner, you will enjoy a high degree of flexibility in your working life. The labour market is constantly evolving, and our goal is to make your working life as flexible as possible – with opportunities you rarely find elsewhere.

You can decide:
• Where you want to work
• When you want to work
• How much you want to work

Would you prefer a 4-day working week, work locally, or do you enjoy working as a travelling fitter/technician? There are many possibilities.

Who are we?

Your Partner ApS is a 100% Danish-owned company with 25 years of experience. We employ skilled workers on both temporary assignments and our own projects throughout the construction industry, including:

Carpentry, concrete work, electrical work, plumbing, ventilation, façades and more.

We are affiliated with:
TEKNIQ Arbejdsgiverne, Dansk Metal, Blik & Rør and 3F.

Interested?

Send us your application or contact us for more information.

We look forward to hearing from you!

info@yourpartner.dk

jobs.title: Myyjä, Prisma Nummelan käyttötavaraosasto
jobs.description:
Primary location:
VIHTI

Etsimme Prisma Nummelan käyttötavaraosastolle MYYJÄÄ! Tehtävä on vakituinen ja sen työtunnit ovat 30 h/vko. Tutustu Nummelan Prisman tunnelmaan somesta, ja saatatpa bongata tulevien työkavereiden kasvojakin!

Prisma Nummelan monipuolisella käyttötavaraosastolla pääset työskentelemään laajan tuotevalikoiman parissa. Valikoimaamme kuuluu mm. viihde-elektroniikkaa, kodinkoneita, vaatteita sekä sisustus-, piha- ja puutarhatuotteita. Tässä tehtävässä työsi painottuu erityisesti viihde-elektroniikan osastolle, jossa autat asiakkaita löytämään juuri heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivia tuotteita – olipa kyseessä uuden puhelimen valinta, television hankinta tai sopivien lisätarvikkeiden etsiminen. Lisäksi osallistut muun elektroniikan ja kodinkoneiden myyntiin sekä tuet tarvittaessa koko käyttötavaraosastoa monipuolisissa tehtävissä.

Käyttötavaraosaston myyjän työ sopii sinulle, joka innostut asiakaspalvelusta ja vauhdikkaasta työarjesta. Huolehdit siitä, että tuotteet ovat siististi ja houkuttelevasti esillä, hallitset varastoa ja rakennat kampanjoita. Lisäksi huolehdit huoltoihin liittyvistä asioista ja reklamaatioista. Yksi tehtävä on kuitenkin ylitse muiden: asiakkaiden ystävällinen kohtaaminen. 😊

Toivomme, että pidät asiakaspalvelusta, fyysisestä työstä ja tiimityöskentelystä. Aiempi kokemus tai harrastuneisuus viihde-elektroniikan parissa on edellytys, joten kerrothan osaamisestasi hakemuksella. Edellytämme 18 vuoden ikää ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä Prisman aamu- päivä- ja iltavuoroissa vaihtelevasti n. klo 7–22 välillä.

Haluamme vastaavasti tarjota sinulle
💚 Supervoimia S-etukortillesi! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai -15 % alennus käyttötavaroista mm. Prismoista ja Sokokselta? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakua täältä.
💸 Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkaa koulutuksesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Tuntipalkkasi tulee sijoittumaan välille 11,16–14,31 € /h. Ja lisät päälle!
💰 Mahdollisuuden vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon.
💎 Arvokasta kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta, myynnistä ja tiimityöstä. Näitä taitoja tarvitaan lähes jokaisessa työpaikassa, joten tilaisuus kerryttää kokemusta kannattaa käyttää hyödyksi.
🛒 Mahdollisuuden tehdä lisätöitä joko Prisman eri osastoilla tai muissa SSO:n toimipisteissä. Tämä kerryttää osaamistasi ja kasvattaa mukavasti tilipussia.

Lisätiedot ja hakeminen
Työsuhteen tyyppi: vakituinen
Työaika: osa-aikainen 30 h/vko
Haku päättyy: 23.8.2026. Toivomme kuulevamme sinusta pian, sillä haastattelemme jo hakuajalla ja valinta tehdään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

📞 Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa myyntipäällikkö Kirsi Finerus, p. 044320 5604 kirsi.finerus@sok.fi

💚Me SSO:ssa olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.

Työnantajakuvaus
Me SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. Myyjä, tarjoilija, asiantuntija ja tuhat muuta – me kaikki teemme yhdessä kotiseudustamme parempaa paikkaa elää. Siksi meidät valittiinkin yhdeksi Suomen Innostavimmista työpaikoista vuonna 2025. jobs.title: CNC-operatør til drej
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med store komponenter til vindindustrien og den tunge industri? Vil du have et job, hvor det, du producerer, bliver brugt globalt? Ønsker du at være en del af en virksomhed, der sætter en ære i kvalitet, samarbejde og godt håndværk?

Vi søger en CNC-operatør til drejeopgaver på vores fabrik i Sæby. Hos Nordmark er vi specialister i bearbejdning af store emner – blandt andet til vindindustrien. Med over 20 års erfaring i branchen har vi opbygget en stærk ekspertise og en kultur, hvor samarbejde, vidensdeling og lysten til at hjælpe hinanden er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Vi prioriterer tæt samarbejde på tværs af fabrikken for at styrke relationer og optimere vores processer. Vi tror på, at nysgerrighed, faglig udvikling og en løsningsorienteret tilgang er nøglen til succes.

Vores medarbejdere er vores vigtigste ressource, og vi prioriterer derfor sikkerhed og trivsel højt. Som en del af Nordmark forventer vi, at du deler disse værdier og bidrager aktivt til et stærkt arbejdsmiljø.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team, hvor vi løfter i flok, tager ansvar og hjælper hinanden. Du vil opleve en høj grad af selvstyring, men også et tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger, fordi vi ved, at de bedste resultater skabes sammen.

Dine primære opgaver vil bestå i bearbejdning af store emner på:

  • Honor Seiki PL-350CM CNC karruseldrejebænk med X- og Y-akser (Fanuc 32i-model B styring)

  • Giana drejebænke med Siemens-styring

Vi tror på, at det rette mindset er lige så vigtigt som den faglige erfaring

Derfor lægger vi især vægt på, at du:

  • Er uddannet maskinarbejder eller industritekniker – eller har tilsvarende erfaring.

  • Er løsningsorienteret og trives med at få ting til at ske.

  • Er mødestabil og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Kommunikerer åbent og bidrager til et godt samarbejde.

  • Er en holdspiller, som gerne hjælper kolleger – også når opgaven ligger uden for dit eget fagområde.

  • Har et positivt humør og bidrager til en god stemning i hverdagen.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig se værdien i fællesskabet.

Når du bliver en del af Nordmark, bliver du også en del af en kultur, hvor vores fem kerneværdier – Competent, Credible, Collaborative, Climate-friendly og Committed – ikke blot står på væggen, men er noget, vi arbejder efter hver dag.

Vi tilbyder

  • En selvstændig og udfordrende stilling i en uformel virksomhed.

  • En spændende arbejdsplads i vækst med et stærkt fagligt og socialt miljø.

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn, sundhedsforsikring og pension.

Interesse

Er du klar til at blive en del af Nordmark?

Så send dit CV og en kort ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Production Manager - Turning Sune Nørager på mobil 29674393.

 

 

Om Nordmark
Nordmark er specialister i præcisionsbearbejdning af store komponenter til det globale vindenergimarked. Som totalleverandør til vind- og sværindustrien sætter vi en ære i konstant innovation og dybdegående ekspertise.

Vi er en fremsynet virksomhed, hvor innovation driver vores succes. Vores engagement i teknologidrevet udvikling og bæredygtighed sikrer, at vi altid ligger et skridt foran i branchens udvikling.

Med årtiers erfaring har vi opbygget en unik knowhow, og vi er stolte af vores højt kvalificerede medarbejdere, der besidder en indgående forståelse for de komplekse udfordringer, vores løsninger adresserer. Denne ekspertise udnytter vi til at levere integrerede løsninger, teknisk support og avancerede belægninger, som sikrer optimal ydeevne og lang levetid.

Vi arbejder målrettet på at integrere bæredygtighed i alle aspekter af vores forretningsmodel – fra reduktion af CO₂-aftryk og optimering af ressourceforbruget til etisk praksis og fremme af social inklusion.

Bliv en del af vores team, og vær med til at skabe de komponenter, der baner vejen for en bæredygtig fremtid for kommende generationer.

Nordmark er ejet af investeringsfonden CataCap.

jobs.title: Data Center IT management Engineer
jobs.description:
**Responsibilities**

Team Insight: The DataCenter Service / Datacenter Cloud System (DCS) team sits within TikTok's global technology structure and supports the company's fast growth by building and operating hyper-scale datacenters, managing the life cycle of server fleet, providing cloud solutions, and developing various infrastructure services, making sure they are scalable and are reliable.

Role Insight: We are seeking an experienced Data Center Operations Engineers to apply technical expertise in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This role requires strong knowledge of server hardware and a foundational understanding of mechanical and electrical infrastructure in large-scale data centers. You will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving server and infrastructure issues, collaborating with remote teams, and supporting the full server rack lifecycle, including buildout of compute and storage environments. In addition, you will lead and guide DC Technicians, ensuring high-quality execution of operational tasks and adherence to best practices. Candidates should have hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas: Networking, Scripting, or Hardware Repair. Success in this role requires strong communication skills, the ability to work independently and within a team, and adaptability in a rapidly changing environment.

Responsibilities:

\- Own day-to-day IT infrastructure operations across assigned data centre sites, ensuring uptime and SLA compliance for all break-fix activity.

\- Lead daily operations by guiding Data Center Technicians and overseeing task allocation, hardware troubleshooting, maintenance, and diagnostics.

\- Manage the full incident and change lifecycle, resolving incidents to SLA, executing changes under formal change control, and leading root cause analysis and corrective actions to closure.

\- Track and report IT operational performance metrics, including availability, MTTR, ticket ageing, first-time fix, break-fix volumes, and rack capacity utilisation, using trend analysis to drive continuous improvement.

\- Manage data centre IT on-site stability, identifying risk events and driving improvement initiatives to enhance stability and reduce operational errors.

\- Support data centre projects and operational improvements, including capacity expansions, retrofits, infrastructure upgrades, and implementation of new tools and processes; support new site builds and operational handover readiness.

\- Maintain and improve site documentation (SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, escalation matrices), build strong cross-functional relationships, act as an escalation point, and identify recurring issues to drive vendor escalation and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

Minimum Qualifications:

\- 5+ years of experience in data centre operations, IT infrastructure, hardware support, and structured cabling in a live data centre environment.

\- Strong hands-on knowledge of server, storage, and network hardware, including component-level diagnostics and replacement.

\- Capable of server disassembly, hardware replacement, rack deployment, and hardware fault diagnosis with component-level troubleshooting across server and rack systems.

\- Basic Linux OS administration and BMC/BIOS configuration skills.

\- Basic understanding of critical facility infrastructure (UPS, generators, PDUs, CRAC/CRAH, cooling topology) to work safely alongside facilities teams.

\- Competent with DCIM, ticketing, and monitoring platforms, with the ability to analyse ticket data to identify recurring faults and support IT infrastructure performance.

\- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to report to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications

\- Relevant certification such as CDCP, CDCS, ITIL Foundation, CompTIA Server+, or CCNA.

\- Experience in large-scale data centre environments. - Strong working knowledge of data centre power infrastructure and cooling systems, with proven competence in identifying server overheating risks and responding to power emergencies.

\- Hands-on experience operating and maintaining GPU servers and integrated rack systems, including hardware troubleshooting on GB300, B200, or comparable GPU platforms (e.g., GPU error analysis, NVLink fault diagnosis).

\-Experience coordinating vendors, outsourced technicians, or smart-hand resources on site.

\- Experience supporting projects, incident management, or small team leadership.

\- Willingness to participate in on-call rotation and travel to other sites as required.

jobs.title: Customer account manager (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Helicopter Engines est le leader mondial des moteurs d'hélicoptères et le seul industriel à s'être spécialisé sur ce marché. Implantée dans le monde entier, la société emploie 6100 personnes dans le monde et possède plus de 2 500 clients répartis dans 155 pays et plus de 21 500 moteurs en service.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionRole Overview

As Customer Account Manager, you will own the short-, mid- and long-term commercial performance of an assigned portfolio of overseas customers, in line with Safran Helicopter Engines' strategy and 5-year plan.



You will be the primary commercial interface for helicopter operators, working closely with internal stakeholders and local airframers to grow business, strengthen customer loyalty and ensure profitable contract execution. The role involves up to 50% international travel, primarily within Asia.



Success will be measured by revenue growth, market share expansion, customer satisfaction, contract profitability and effective cash management.



Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Business Development

o Define and execute short- and mid-term commercial strategies aligned with company objectives

o Identify and develop new business opportunities within the assigned customer portfolio

o Build and manage a rolling 12-month sales forecast, tracking risks and opportunities

o Drive sales growth, market share expansion and service contract penetration



Customer & Contract Management

o Lead commercial negotiations in line with company policies and governance

o Prepare, structure and present commercial offers within Safran's framework

o Manage contract renewals, reviews and service agreement negotiations

o Ensure full contract execution, compliance and performance

o Optimise contract margins, including management of invoicing, discounts and commercial gestures



Financial & Cash Management

o Steer financial performance across turnover, margin, invoicing and cash

o Lead cash collection activities and follow up on outstanding receivables

o Ensure profitability targets are achieved and sustained



Customer Satisfaction & Stakeholder Coordination

o Act as the customer satisfaction lead, ensuring service quality across technical support, material supply and responsiveness

o Coordinate closely with customer service, technical teams and internal stakeholders to resolve issues

o Manage customer visits, feedback, surveys and complaints, with accurate reporting via Safran tools

o Provide guidance to customer service teams on customer-related matters



Governance & Continuous Improvement

o Ensure compliance with internal controls, contractual obligations and commercial policies

o Contribute actively to continuous improvement initiatives

jobs.title: Apulaispäällikkö, S-market Pielavesi
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PIELAVESI

S-MARKET PIELAVESI etsii nyt APULAISPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ VAKITUISEEN KOKOAIKAISEEN TYÖSUHTEESEEN - ihan tavallisiin töihin, erityisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon

Sopimustunnit: 37,5 t/vk
Työ alkaa: sopimuksen mukaan

Meillä tavallisuus tarkoittaa hyvää ja sujuvaa työarkea – meillä töitä tehdään #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä. Työ ei ole pelkkää juhlaa - mutta ei myöskään tylsää harmaata arkea. Olemme mukana asiakkaiden arjessa ja juhlassa - kun ostetaan maitoa ja kun haetaan kakku juhlapöytään. Ja toisinaan toki juhlimme itsekin. Jos olet kyllästynyt kliseisiin kuten "päivät eivät ole koskaan samanlaisia" ja "meillä on aina hauskaa töissä", tule meille tekemään ihan tavallista, mutta tärkeää työtä.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos olet vastuuntuntoinen, toimeenpanokykyinen ja omaat erinomaiset vuorovaikutustaidot - ja jos tykkäät poikkeuksellisen hyvistä henkilökunta-aleista, mukavasta työporukasta ja siitä tunteesta, kun asiakas lähtee hymyillen.

Apulaispäällikkönä päivääsi kuuluu myymälän arjen pyörittämistä marketpäällikön apuna - varmistat, että hommat rullaavat, tiimillä on hyvä fiilis ja asiakkaat saavat parhaan mahdollisen palvelun. Luotsaat sujuvia työpäiviä työntekijäkokemuksen kautta: olet läsnä vuoroissa, tuet tiimiä arjen tilanteissa ja huolehdit, että työskentely on sujuvaa ja tavoitteellista. Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu myös asiakaspalvelua, hyllytystä ja myymälän tuloksellisen toiminnan varmistamista. Pääset kehittämään toimintaa, tarttumaan haasteisiin ja etsimään uusia tapoja tehostaa arkea.

Haemme henkilöä, jolla on aito palo toimia tiimin vetäjänä - arjen sujuvoittajana, joka pitää suunnan selkeänä ja porukan motivoituneena. Asiakaspalvelu on sinulle enemmän kuin työ, se on tapa toimia, ja viet esimerkilläsi koko tiimin kohti vieläkin parempaa asiakaskokemusta päivä toisensa jälkeen. Mahdollistat tuloksellisuutta yhdessä marketpäällikön kanssa ja halu elää PeeÄssän arvoja todeksi näkyy tekemisessäsi ja innostaa myös tiimiäsi.

Edellytämme kokemusta marketkaupan työstä ja valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa toimipaikan aukioloaikojen mukaan, myös juhlapyhinä.

Arvostamme kykyä suunnitella ja toteuttaa päivittäisiä myymälätoimintoja, valmiutta ottaa vastuuta ja johtaa myös itsenäisesti sekä kykyä reagoida nopeastikin asiakkaiden tarpeisiin.

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on
- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.
- Rahaa: työehtosopimuksen mukainen myyjän palkka, jonka lisänä 10 % vastuulisä. Vuorolisät tuovat kivasti extraa, ne maksetaan myös TES:n mukaisesti.
- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräistä jopa 2 kuukauden palkka vuodessa.
- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Meillä ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee myös ystäviä.
- Mahdollisuus kehittyä ja vaihtaa tehtäviä tai alaa – jos itse haluat.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan - me odotamme sinua.

Hakuaika päättyy: 31.8.2026. Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja: marketpäällikkö Riku Korhonen, puh. 044 719 7600, riku.korhonen@sok.fi


Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Myymälävastaava
jobs.description:
MYYMÄLÄVASTAAVA LIIZI.FI:LLE – HERTTONIEMI, HELSINKI

**Ma–to klo 10–18 | noin 30 h/vko**

Haluaisitko työn, jossa saat vastuuta, hoitaa omaa kokonaisuuttasi itsenäisesti ja tavata mukavia asiakkaita – vieläpä kolmipäiväisellä viikonlopulla?

Liizi.fi on vähän erilainen kauppa. Meiltä tavaroita ei ensisijaisesti osteta, vaan niitä vuokrataan silloin, kun niitä tarvitaan. Valikoimassamme on satoja erilaisia tuotteita tekstiilipesureista ja työkaluista lastentarvikkeisiin, juhlavälineisiin, telttoihin ja elektroniikkaan.

Etsimme nyt **myymälävastaavaa** Kauppakeskus Hertsissä sijaitsevaan myymäläämme.

Mitä työ sisältää?

Vastaat itsenäisesti myymälän ja varaston päivittäisestä toiminnasta. Työhösi kuuluu:

- asiakkaiden palveleminen sekä vuokratuotteiden luovutus ja vastaanotto

- palautuneiden tuotteiden tarkastus, puhdistus ja kevyt huolto

- tuotteiden pakkaaminen ja lähettäminen asiakkaille

- myymälän ja varaston järjestyksestä, siisteydestä ja toimivuudesta huolehtiminen

- monenlaisten päivittäisten käytännön tilanteiden ratkaiseminen

- myös jonkin verran painavampien tuotteiden, kuten puolijoukkuetelttojen ja taittokalusteiden, käsittelyä.


Työ on monipuolista ja käytännönläheistä. Yhtenä hetkenä neuvot asiakasta tekstiilipesurin käytössä, seuraavaksi tarkistat palautuneet lastenrattaat, pakkaat tuotteen lähetettäväksi tai selvität, miksi jokin laite ei toimi kuten pitäisi.

Työ edellyttää myös **kohtuullisen hyvää fyysistä toimintakykyä**, sillä osa vuokratuotteistamme on kookkaita ja painavia.

Millaisen ihmisen haluaisimme löytää?

Tämä on meille kaikkein tärkein asia.

Etsimme **positiivista, luotettavaa ja kokenutta ihmistä**, jolle voimme antaa vastuuta ja luottaa siihen, että asiat tulevat hoidetuiksi.

Toivomme sinulta erityisesti:

- vahvaa kykyä itsenäiseen ja itseohjautuvaan työskentelyyn

- positiivista ja ystävällistä asennetta sekä hyvää asiakaspalveluhenkeä

- tervettä käytännön järkeä ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä

- kykyä hahmottaa, **mikä on tärkeää juuri nyt ja mikä voi odottaa**

- tapaa tehdä työt huolellisesti mutta samalla **järkevästi ja tehokkaasti**

- järjestelmällisyyttä ja vastuullisuutta

- kiinnostusta erilaisiin tuotteisiin, laitteisiin ja niiden toimintaan

- hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja kykyä palvella asiakkaita myös englanniksi

- valmiutta myös fyysiseen työhön ja painavampien tuotteiden käsittelyyn.


Meille ei ole tärkeintä tietty koulutus, titteli tai se, miltä CV näyttää. **Arvostamme työ- ja elämänkokemusta sekä ihmistä, joka osaa ajatella itse, tarttua toimeen ja pitää kokonaisuuden hallinnassa.**

Sinun ei myöskään tarvitse tuntea satoja tuotteitamme valmiiksi. Perehdytämme tehtävään. Uteliaisuus ja halu oppia ovat tärkeämpiä.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Saat vastuullisen ja vaihtelevan työn pienessä suomalaisessa yrityksessä, jossa oman työn jäljen näkee konkreettisesti.

Työaika on **maanantaista torstaihin klo 10–18**, noin 30 tuntia viikossa. Perjantait ja viikonloput ovat vapaita.

Työpaikka sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella **Kauppakeskus Hertsissä Herttoniemessä**.

Liizin toiminnan ajatuksena on tehdä vuokraamisesta helppo vaihtoehto tavaroiden ostamiselle. Samoja laadukkaita tuotteita käyttää niiden elinkaaren aikana suuri määrä asiakkaita – kaikkea ei tarvitse omistaa itse.

**Arvostamme kokemusta – myös pitkää työuraa.** Tehtävä voi sopia erinomaisesti kokeneelle työntekijälle, joka etsii pitkäaikaista, itsenäistä ja vastuullista työtä.

Tehtävään voidaan mahdollisuuksien mukaan hyödyntää palkkatukea tai 55 vuotta täyttäneiden työllistämistukea.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä meille lyhyt hakemus, jossa kerrot itsestäsi, aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi ja siitä, miksi juuri tällainen työ kiinnostaisi sinua.

Emme kaipaa pitkää muodollista hakemusta. Haluamme ennen kaikkea löytää **hyvän, positiivisen ja vastuullisen tyypin, joka viihtyisi Liizillä pitkään.**

**Liizi.fi Oy** Kauppakeskus Hertsi Herttoniemi, Helsinki

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

The Data team works across Linear, supporting Product, Engineering, and GTM. We own our data pipelines, warehouse, dashboards, analysis, and integrations with third-party tools. As a small team, we focus on building systems that make data accessible and useful across Linear. We’re looking for someone who wants to help shape how we architect, build, and use data as we grow.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Work across Product and GTM (Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance) to turn ambiguous questions and operational needs into useful metrics, models, analyses, and workflows

 - Build and maintain dbt models and pipelines that create trusted views of our product, customers, and business

 - Design clear, maintainable data models and improve the testing, documentation, performance, and reliability of our data stack

 - Build dashboards and self-service reporting in Metabase and Hex, and dig deeper when the answer requires more than a chart

 - Operationalize data through reverse ETL and partner with GTM Engineering on the scoring, segmentation, automations, and internal tools that help our teams scale

 - Balance fast, pragmatic answers with durable solutions, recognizing when a one-off request should become a reusable model or workflow

 - Find ways to leverage emerging tools, LLMs, and coding agents to accelerate development, analysis, testing, and documentation while maintaining a high bar for correctness

What we're looking for

 - 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or data engineering, ideally at a fast-moving software company

 - Exceptional SQL and strong hands-on experience with dbt and a modern cloud data warehouse

 - Track record of owning data projects end-to-end, from shaping an ambiguous problem to shipping something people rely on

 - Strong data modeling judgment: you think clearly about grain, reusable components, interfaces, dependencies, and maintainability without relying on a single prescribed methodology

 - Analytical judgment: you know when to answer quickly, when to investigate deeply, and how to turn complex findings into a clear recommendation

 - Comfortable moving between technical implementation and business context, from debugging a data model to understanding product adoption or sales efficiency

 - High ownership mentality: self-directed, pragmatic, and willing to challenge a request or approach when something does not make sense

 - Strong communication skills and experience partnering directly with both technical and non-technical teams

 - Comfortable using LLMs and coding agents as part of your day-to-day development workflow

Our tech

This stack reflects the systems you’ll work in. You’re not expected to have experience with everything listed, but you should be comfortable learning quickly and working across the full lifecycle of data.

 - Data Warehouse: Snowflake, dbt Cloud

 - Dashboards / Analysis: Metabase, Hex

 - ETL / rETL: Hevo, Fivetran

 - GTM tools: Hubspot, Pocus, Clay

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

jobs.title: Deal Desk
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Linear is in a unique position—we are profitable, which gives us the flexibility to invest thoughtfully as we grow. We want to build a company that scales well—not just in our product, but in how we run our GTM programs. In this role, you’ll design and evolve the systems and process that power our deal desk process. This person will help build the mechanics behind our sales-led deals: quotes, order forms, pricing, discount approvals, and contract terms. A strong candidate has run quote-to-cash at a SaaS company and can spot where the process is slow, manual, or leaky.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America (west coast). We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Own the quote-to-order-form workflow: accurate quotes, correct terms, and a clean path from verbal yes to signed and billed

 - Build and run the deal approval and discount matrix, so Account Executives know what they can self-serve and what needs sign-off

 - Be the single point of contact for deal structuring questions that today land on Account Executives mid-deal

 - Partner with Finance and Legal to keep the order-to-cash process clean, controlled, and free of revenue leakage

 - Support usage-based and consumption deals as AI billing rolls out, from how they are quoted through the hand-off to billing

 - Find and remove manual work: automate what can be automated, document what needs to be documented

 - Help us get and stay audit ready by making sure deals are recorded correctly

What we're looking for

 - 3-5 years in deal desk, order management, revenue operations, or quote-to-cash, ideally at a high-growth SaaS company

 - Strong command of the full quote-to-cash cycle, from pricing and approvals through order form and billing hand-off

 - Comfortable building process from scratch: workflows, approval logic, controls, and documentation, without a playbook handed to you

 - Sound judgment on the tradeoff between deal speed and control, and on sensitive pricing and deal information

 - A clear communicator who can hold a deal conversation with an Account Executive, Finance, and a customer, and have each one walk away with what they need

 - Proficiency with CRM and quoting tools; experience with usage-based billing, multi-currency, or CPQ is a strong plus

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

jobs.title: IT Security Expert (m/f)
jobs.description:
IT Security Expert
Luxembourg, LU, L-2449

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve.
We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg, with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands and a subsidiary in the UK. We are supervised by the CSSF with an ambition to stay true to our purpose to be the most trusted fiduciary of family wealth.
When you join Quintet you are joining a company that values diversity of background, equal access to opportunities, career development, collaboration and inclusiveness. We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

We are looking for a skilled IT Security Expert with strong hands-on network administration expertise to join our dynamic IT Security team.
The role combines IT Security Infrastructure management with deep operational knowledge of enterprise network infrastructures, ensuring that security controls are effectively implemented, and operated across on premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
The successful candidate will work as part of the ITS Group Function – Network & Security Team in Quintet Luxembourg.

Key Accountabilities

• Operate the Bank Security Infrastructure (Run the Bank) including firewall policies, VPNs, IPS/IDS, and mail gateways.
• Penetration Testing Coordination: Coordinate and support penetration testing efforts, analysing findings, and working with teams to address identified security weaknesses.
• Vulnerabilities Process Follow-Up: Monitor and track the status of identified vulnerabilities, ensuring that remediation efforts are executed efficiently and effectively. Manage the process and provide reporting associated
• Patching Follow-Up: Manage and oversee the patch management process including EDR follow up, ensuring timely application of security updates and addressing vulnerabilities in a proactive manner.
• Security Dashboard Creation: Develop and maintain security dashboards to provide real-time visibility into security metrics, vulnerabilities, and incident response efforts for stakeholders
• Operate the day to day data leakage prevention (DLP) and data exfiltration monitoring activities, including detection, investigation, and remediation of potential data leaks across network, endpoint, cloud, and perimeter layers.
• Technical Risk Analysis Support: Assist in conducting technical risk assessments and analyses to identify potential security threats and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
• Access Validation: provide guidance for specific access request by following Access control policy principles
• Maintain and secure the group network infrastructure, including Lan, Wan, SD-WAN, VPN, Bank Wireless network and cloud networking.  
• Ensure secure connectivity between on-premises environments and cloud platforms
• Collaboration: Work closely with IT teams, including CISO, to integrate security into all aspects of the organization's IT landscape.    
    
Knowledge and Experience

• 5+ years of experience in IT Security, with strong hands-on experience in enterprise network administration.
• Strong knowledge of security frameworks and best practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001).
• Proven experience in network and security operations within complex environments.
• Experience with penetration testing methodologies and tools.
• Familiarity with security technologies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, and SIEM solutions.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
• Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CEH, CISM, CCNP Security, etc) are highly desirable.  
• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Attributes and Qualities

• Adaptability & Learning Agility                        
• Time Management                                
• Communication (Verbal & Written)                    
• Client-Centric Mindset                            
• Collaborative Teamwork

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge in Security Frameworks and Standards. Knowledge of security frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls) and Compliance regulations (GDPR, DORA, etc)
• Strong knowledge Firewall Next Generation (VPN, IPS, Anti-malware, Sandbox, URL Filtering, ...); Mail & Web gateways;
• Knowledge in VPN and Remote access solutions
• Knowledge in Endpoints Security (antivirus, antimalware)
• Knowledge in Threat Intelligence and Vulnerability Management - Ability to analyse threat intelligence and conduct vulnerability assessments. Familiarity with security tools (SIEM, vulnerability scanners).  

Languages Skills

• Excellent written and oral French and English skills are essential, any other language is an advantage

jobs.description:
Sr. Manager Ops Concessions, EU Quality
Job ID: 10489000 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

*Please note: This position can be based in any of the following corporate offices: LUX20, MAN11 Manchester, MAD12 Madrid, LHR140 London

Are you passionate about improving the customer experience? Do you strive to design and deploy customer-centric solutions that drive measurable results? Does coordinating across teams and countries sound exciting? If so, we are looking for a Sr. Manager to focus on reducing Concessions in EU Operations. You will manage large-scale programs that improve the customer experience and find ways to positively surprise our customers with our services.

We are looking to hire an experienced leader to join the EU Quality leadership team, with background in Amazon Operations. As a Sr. Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing programs that improve both customer experience and efficiency by process improvements. Achieving such aspirational goals will require insisting on the highest standards, developing and iterating on new processes, and driving continuous improvement activities internally and externally. You will build collaborative relationships with numerous teams (operations, tech, and corporate) to identify solutions and to create a project roadmap. You will also prepare and execute regular program updates to senior management on a weekly and monthly basis.

As a Senior Manager in the EU Ops Concessions team, you will lead a team of managers to deliver a critical goal that will directly impact Amazon's P&L. Your objective is to reduce the defect rate and the cost of items that are not delivered to customers and not returned to Amazon. This is a new workstream where you will have the opportunity to innovate and deliver at scale.
These defects often do not reside within a single operations business line but span multiple functions, including first mile (FC), middle mile (ATS), last mile (AMZL, Carrier) and Reverse logistics. You will work closely with senior leaders to influence decision-making and guide them to focus on high-impact areas by creating clear business cases that consider trade-offs.
The success of this role will depend on your ability to successfully deliver programs and improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration. You will need to demonstrate a strong Bias for Action to achieve the team's goals.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the goal of reducing DPMO and costs for the "not delivered – not returned" metrics across EU Amazon.
- Responsible for the operating planning (OP1/OP2) cycles for the program.
- Deliver OP2 savings through initiatives that impact this goal.
- Dive Deep into data to identify the biggest operational opportunities in a new area with a lot of ambiguity.
- Actively seek operational improvement opportunities to ensure items are safely returned to the FC in good condition if they are not delivered.
- Develop and guide team members to focus on the most impactful areas of opportunity.
- Identify trends and take ownership to solve problems. Escalate any delays in timely manner which puts deliverables at risks.
- Support teams (FC, AMZL, GTS, ATS, Relo FC) in prioritizing initiatives to create an end-to-end secure network.
- Lead WBR, MBR, and QBR with end-to-end senior stakeholders (including L8, L10).

A day in the life

You will manage a team of Program Managers and technical team members who will collaborate with various tech, operations, and business stakeholders to drive business-critical programs. You'll challenge and guide the team to ensure timely progress and the completion of their deliverables, coordinate their efforts, and address any lack of traction or adoption where necessary.
You will take ownership of the goal, stay focused on delivering the roadmap, and regularly review milestones. Lead discussion with finance partners to ensure savings glidepaths are met. You'll identify trends early and act without delay. Regularly influence other business lines to maintain focus on the right areas and escalate any delays that put deliverables at risk.

About the team

EU Ops Concessions oversees E2E Ops Controllable Concessions, Undeliverables, and Unreturned items for the EU Amazon Fulfilment network. The team runs EU-wide initiatives aimed at improving the customer experience by identifying, analysing, and resolving operational defects in the First (FCs), Middle (ATS), Last-mile (Carriers and AMZL), and Transportation networks. The products developed by the team are rolled out across the EU Amazon Fulfilment network. As our tools have become the standard in the EU, some have already been adopted by global stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or Master's degree
- Experience leading and managing a team
- Experience leading complex programs with significant change impact across organizational boundaries
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or a Master's degree and experience working for Amazon or any Amazon subsidiary or affiliate
- Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
- Experience with roadmap strategy and definition

jobs.description:
Amentum is seeking a Message Center Operator to support the Atlantic Undersea Test and Evaluation Center (AUTEC) Mission in Andros Island, Bahamas. AUTEC is a Major Range and Test Facility Base (MRTFB) and the Naval Undersea Warfare Center, Division Newport's largest single team project, providing both deep and shallow water test and training environments. The Message Center Operator is responsible for maintaining strict accountability for Local Element CMS/EKMS and other associated classified materials, records, and equipment in the Communications Message Center. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Collections Infra
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume.

 - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping.

 - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage.

 - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on.

 - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load.

 - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles.

 - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter.

 - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck.

 - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Kundservicemedarbetare på Mallorca - Dag/Natt
jobs.description:
Har du service i fokus, gillar att hjälpa andra och vill ha en vardag i solen?

Vår kundserviceavdelning är i en otrolig tillväxtfas och därför söker vi nu höstens nya kollegor. Totalt 10 platser ska tillsättas till vårt kontor i Palma de Mallorca. Vi söker dig som vill ta nästa steg i sin karriär eller upptäcka livet utomlands.

Hos Nordic Operation Center arbetar vi med både kundservice och telefonförsäljning för några av Nordens starkaste varumärken. Vi har byggt en prestationsdriven miljö med tydliga mål, tävlingar och en stark teamkultur.

Tänk dig att avsluta arbetsdagen och kunna ta en promenad längs stranden, träna i solen eller äta middag i Palma tillsammans med dina nya kollegor, här kombinerar du karriär med livsstil.

Anställning kommer att ske löpande så tveka inte på att skicka in din ansöka, kanske är det just dig vi söker!

Om rollen

Som kundservicemedarbetare arbetar du med inkommande kundärenden via telefon. Du hjälper kunder på ett professionellt och effektivt sätt, där kvalitet och bemötande alltid står i fokus.

I rollen kan arbetstiderna variera mellan dag, kväll och natt beroende på vilket projekt du tilldelas.

Arbetet innebär bland annat att:

    Hantera bokningar och avbokningar
    Hjälpa både privat- och företagskunder
    Arbeta mot tydliga mål kopplade till kundnöjdhet och effektivitet

Du blir en viktig del av teamet där din insats direkt påverkar både kundupplevelsen och resultatet.

Vi erbjuder

    Heltidstjänst med stegrande lön
    20 dagars betald semester per år
    Betald introduktion och utbildning
    Möjlighet att utvecklas och göra karriär inom bolaget
    En arbetsplats med stark gemenskap och högt engagemang
    Möjlighet att bo och arbeta i Spanien
    Hjälp med spanska dokument (NIE & socialförsäkring)
    Bostadshjälp där vi hjälper dig med kontaktuppgifter till både mäklare och hyresvärdar.

Vi söker dig som

    Är noggrann, strukturerad och stresstålig
    Trivs med att arbeta i ett högt tempo
    Är bekväm med telefon och dator som arbetsverktyg
    Behärskar svenska flytande i tal och skrift samt har grundläggande engelska
    Är flexibel och kan anpassa dig efter verksamhetens behov

Är du rätt person för jobbet?

Tjänsten passar dig som är redo att göra något nytt, hitta en ny vardag eller utvecklas snabbt inom kundservice. Du är positiv, målinriktad och arbetar effektivt mot uppsatta mål med hög kvalité. Den viktigaste pelaren på Nordic Operation Center är vår kultur. Vår vision är att bygga ett andra hem för vårt team där vi alltid sätter våra medarbetare i fokus.

Tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande men inget krav. Är du vårt nästa stjärnskott eller har du det som krävs för att bli det? Vi söker efter nya stjärnor men vi är också med och skapar dem från grunden!

Position Summary:

The Electrician specializes in the maintenance and safe operation of all electrical equipment on the Private Destination, this includes high voltage equipment. This role diagnoses issues, fixes equipment, and maintains records of inspections. This position demonstrates exemplary skills in overhauling and maintaining all electrical equipment. The Electrician follows all safety protocols to ensure the safety of Guests, visitors, and fellow Team Members. This role is committed to a safety-first culture to ensure optimum safety for Guests, Visitors, and Team Members.

All duties and responsibilities are performed following Companyâs Brand Standards, the Royal Way philosophy, policies, and SOPs, public health, safety, security, and environmental guidelines.

The nature of this job requires daily interactions with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ensures safe operation of all electrical equipment in the kitchen venues and laundry rooms.

  • Uses clear, concise, and professional communication in person, over the radio, and in written format.
  • Demonstrates effective teamwork and collaboration, and time management skills.
  • Maintains an orderly and clean work area, with all tools in good repair.

jobs.title: Teknisk Driftskoordinator - ejendomsdrift i servicefirma
jobs.description:
Har du styr på bygningsdrift og kendskab til byggegarantier? Drømmer du om at arbejde i en central rolle indenfor ejendomsdrift og som tæt sparringspartner for kollegaer? Trives du i en hverdag, hvor du primært arbejder fra kontoret i Silkeborg, men også af og til er ude på besigtigelser?

Så vil vi rigtig gerne lære dig bedre at kende!

Hos Dalbøges Ejendomsservice får vi flere opgaver og derfor søger vi en ny kollega, som får en central rolle i den daglige drift af de ejendomme, vi passer.

Du bliver bindeled mellem vores dygtige viceværter og kunder. Nogle dage er du ude og besigtige en ejendom, følger op på garantisager eller flyttesynsopgørelser. Andre dage sidder du på kontoret og udarbejder tilbud, planlægger opgaver eller hjælper med at få en ny ejendom godt i gang.

Det er en alsidig rolle med stor frihed og et stort ansvar – men uden store armbevægelser. Hos os er alle en vigtig del af holdet.

HVORFOR ER DET LIGE NETOP DIG, VI ER PÅ UDKIG EFTER?

Du tager ansvar og får tingene til at ske.

Du bevarer overblikket, når der er mange bolde i luften, og du trives med at finde løsninger sammen med både kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

·         Har erfaring med ejendomsdrift, bygningsdrift eller facility management.

·         Har en god teknisk forståelse og gerne en håndværksmæssig eller byggeteknisk baggrund.

·         Har arbejdet med tekniske gennemgange, mangellister og/eller garantisager.

·         Har forståelse for flyttesyn og processerne rundt om synene.

·         Har lyst til at være den, som viceværterne kan sparre med i hverdagen, og sætter en ære i at deres opgaver er godt koordineret.

·         Er god til at skabe overblik og følge op på opgaver.

·         Er serviceminded og god til at skabe tillid hos kunderne.

·         Er fortrolig med almindelige IT-systemer og Office 365.

Det vigtigste er ikke, hvilken titel du har i dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar, skabe struktur og være med til at udvikle vores forretning.

HVILKE OPGAVER KAN DU SE FREM TIL?

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

·         Sparring og planlægning af opgaver sammen med vores viceværter.

·         Besigtigelse af ejendomme, og udarbejdelse af tilbud og serviceaftaler.

·         Opstart af nye ejendomme og sikring af en god overgang til den daglige drift.

·         Håndtering og opfølgning på garantisager og mangler overfor entreprenører.

·         Dialog med kunder, håndværkere og samarbejdspartnere.

·         Løbende udvikling af vores arbejdsgange og kvaliteten i driften.

HVEM ER VI?

Vi er Dalbøges Ejendomsservice og vi leverer professionel ejendomsservice til udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og erhvervskunder.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, en del af PHM Group og har flere Gazelle-priser bag os. Samtidig har vi bevaret en kultur, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling og hvor alle hjælper hinanden.

Hos os er der ikke langt fra tanke til beslutning. Vi tror på frihed under ansvar, sund fornuft og ordentlighed – både over for kunderne og hinanden.

DET MED SMÅT

Din daglige base bliver vores kontor i Silkeborg, men en del af arbejdstiden vil foregå ude på de ejendomme vi passer. Du vil blandt andet være med til at starte nye ejendomme i Aalborg, når vi udvider vores aktiviteter.

Vi tilbyder en hverdag med stor fleksibilitet, gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuld tid.

VIL DU MED?

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang ansøgning.

Send os i stedet dit CV og et par linjer om, hvorfor du synes, jobbet lyder spændende.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

jobs.title: Globe Advokater søger en advokatsekretær (30-37 timer om ugen)
jobs.description:
Vil du være med på en spændende vækstrejse i et moderne advokatfirma?

Globe Advokater er et ambitiøst og dynamisk advokatfirma med kontor i hjertet af København. Vi er særligt kendt for vores stærke profil inden for udlændingeret og rådgiver både private, virksomheder og internationale klienter i komplekse juridiske problemstillinger.

Samtidig er vi i gang med at udvide vores forretningsområder og arbejder i stigende grad med blandt andet ejendomshandler, familie- og arveret, straffesager og bistandssager. Vi har fokus på høj faglighed, effektiv sagsbehandling og en nærværende klientoplevelse.

Vi oplever stor aktivitet og søger derfor en dygtig og engageret advokatsekretær på 30-37 timer om ugen, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af vores fortsatte udvikling.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Sekretærbetjening og administrativ sagsbehandling

  • Kontakt med klienter, myndigheder og samarbejdspartnere

  • Udarbejdelse af juridiske dokumenter og korrespondance

  • Kalenderstyring, dokumenthåndtering og øvrige administrative opgaver

  • Oprettelse og håndtering af sager samt understøttelse af kontorets advokater

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som advokatsekretær eller fra en lignende stilling

  • Er struktureret, serviceminded og arbejder selvstændigt

  • Har gode skriftlige og mundtlige formuleringsevner

  • Trives i et travlt miljø og har sans for detaljen

  • Har lyst til at være en del af et mindre, ambitiøst team, hvor man hjælper hinanden og får stor indflydelse på hverdagen

Det vil være et stort plus, hvis du tidligere har arbejdet med:

  • Ejendomshandler

  • Bistandssager

  • Straffesager

  • Familie- og arveretlige dokumenter

  • Sagsportalen og digitale sagsgange generelt

Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med Legis, da vi anvender systemet i vores daglige sagsbehandling og ønsker en medarbejder, der kan bidrage aktivt til at udvikle og optimere vores arbejdsgange.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor selvstændighed og ansvar

  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen i et advokatfirma i vækst

  • Et uformelt, fleksibelt og ambitiøst arbejdsmiljø

  • Tæt samarbejde med engagerede kollegaer

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

Ansøgning
Send din ansøgning og CV til info@globeadvokater.dk. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Ansøgningsfrist er den 17. august 2026.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

jobs.title: Project assistant: Formulation development of novel tuberculosis compounds into long acting injectables at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A two-year position within pharmaceutical sciences focusing on formulation development and biopharmaceutical understanding of the performance of novel compounds for the treatment of tuberculosis is available at the Department of Physics, Chemistry, and Pharmacy in the pharmacy research group. 

Starting date: 01 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Application deadline: 31 August 2026

Project background

Long-acting injectables (LAIs) are pharmaceutical products intended for weekly, monthly or with an even lower administration frequency, which provides a continued drug release and thereby a steady exposure of the delivered compound. LAIs are typically administered intramuscularly (IM) or subcutaneously (SC) as oil solutions, in situ forming gels, microspheres, implants, micro- or nanosuspensions, with focus on suspensions in the present work. For individuals suffering of tuberculosis LAIs can provide a huge benefit in disease treatment, due to the long duration time the disease requires. 

LAIs have, with huge clinical success, been applied in the treatment of antipsychotic conditions and the area contains some of the most successful LAI formulations seen from a therapeutic perspective. In the 1960s, oil-based parenteral depot formulations, containing antipsychotics, were introduced in the clinical practice. Since then, the micro- and nanosuspension technology has significantly advanced and many of the more recent LAIs are nano-or microsuspensions. Hence, this is currently one of the important technologies in the field of LAIs and also the focus of the present project. 

The common approach to manipulate the performance of LAI suspensions release rate relies on changing particle size distribution of the crystalline API. This strategy is fundamentally explained by the Noyes-Whitney equation, which describes the dissolution rate of particles in sink conditions. According to the Noyes-Whitney equation, the dissolution rate is proportional to the total surface area of the drug particles. Some commercial products confirms thus and also a few academical studies have reported correlations between the particle size and the in vivo release, hence it is clearly a point that should be clarified when working with a new compound for a LAI suspension. Aside from particle size, other formulation aspects can significantly impact performance, such as formulation composition and the level of flocculation. In addition, API crystal form properties, such as morphology, level of amorphous contents and residual solvent in the API, may have a significant impact on dissolution, indicating that the selection of version and form is crucial not only for manufacturability and stability purposes, but also for performance.

This project aligns closely with Quality by Design (QbD) principles, emphasizing risk assessment, formulation understanding, and robust design space development, but systematically investigating the formulation impact on in vivo release of LAI suspensions in nonclinical models using the obtained data to generate a risk matrix for in vivo impact of potential particle size variations. A successful outcome of this project will provide a formulation that can be taken to clinical trials for the treatment of tuberculosis with the tools to understand the biopharmaceutical performance of LAI suspensions with the relevant compounds supported by quality tools on the stability. 

The work will be conducted in close cooperation with Professor René Holm and other colleagues working on the project.

Qualifications

  • We are looking for a candidate with a strong interest in working with pharmaceutical formulation and evaluation focused on formulation and characterization of suspensions. 

  • The candidate will hold a BSc, a M.Sc. in pharmacy, chemistry, or closely related area. 

  • Previous experiences with one or more of the following are considered an advantage: 

    • formulation design of suspensions, 

    • particle size characterization, 

    • chemical stability studies,

    •  bioanalysis, and 

    • in vivo studies.

The candidate must be independent and fluent in English both orally and written. 

For further information about the position please contact Professor René Holm (reho@sdu.dk).

Natural Science Research – Interdisciplinary Strength

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science, SDU and is located in Odense. At the Department, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines. Read more about our vision here.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Työ alkaa vuokratyösuhteella, ja hyvin sujuneen yhteistyön jatkuessa työsuhteen on mahdollista jatkua asiakasyrityksessä.

jobs.title: Charity Fundraiser, Copenhagen, 15 to 37 hours a week
jobs.description:
Job title:
Charity Fundraiser, Copenhagen. No experience required.

The job

You stand in Copenhagen and stop strangers. You have thirty seconds to make them care about something that matters, and then you ask them to put their money where their heart is.

Most walk past. Some stop. A few say yes, and those are the ones that fund real work by real organisations.

It is the oldest job there is: convince a human being, face to face, with nothing but your voice.

What you actually get out of it

Forget the job. Here is the skill.

By month three you will be able to walk up to anyone, anywhere, and start a conversation that goes somewhere. You will be able to hear no fifteen times and go straight into the sixteenth conversation without flinching. You will know how to ask for something and get it.

Almost nobody has that. The people who do run companies, close deals, get hired over better candidates, and talk their way into rooms they were not invited to.

You cannot learn it from a book. You learn it by doing it four hundred times. We pay you while you do.

The money

Good Guaranteed base +

Commission on top, no ceiling. Holiday allowance and pension on top of that.

The hours

Anywhere from 15 to 37 a week.

Where it goes

We started in February 2026. We are already growing, which means the ladder above you is short and mostly empty. We promote from inside, and people have moved up to team leader in months, not years. Get good and you will be leading people before most of your friends finish their first probation period.

Straight talk

This job is not for everyone, and we would rather tell you now.

Apply

Hit apply. One minute. No CV, no cover letter, no motivation essay.

https://fremtidensfundraising.dk/ansoeg/fundraiser/

We reply within two working days. Interviews every week. Start within two weeks.

Three positions. Questions, call August on 25 78 10 13.

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) de Village Vacances (H/F)
jobs.description:
Prenez la direction d'un village vacances 3* Atout France situé à Sevrier, à 8 km d'Annecy, offrant une vue panoramique sur le lac et un cadre exceptionnel pour des séjours en pension complète ou demi-pension. Vous serez responsable de la gestion globale du village, de la satisfaction client, du management des équipes et de la performance opérationnelle et financière de la structure.
Typologies de clients principales : Séminaires (accueil de groupes professionnels), Groupes loisirs (associations, clubs, comités d'entreprise), Familles (séjours multigénérationnels, animations adaptées).
Ouverture : Toute l'année (fermeture annuelle 4 semaines février / mars).

VOS MISSIONS :
Vous serez le garant de l'excellence opérationnelle, de la rentabilité et de l'expérience client au sein d'un village de 155 chambres (rénovées en 2020), doté d'un restaurant panoramique, d'un bar, d'une piscine extérieure, d'un parc paysager de 3,5 ha, et d'équipements dédiés aux loisirs.
1. RELATION CLIENT ET SATISFACTION
- Garantir une expérience client irréprochable pour les trois typologies (séminaires, groupes loisirs, familles).
- Piloter la qualité des prestations (hébergement, restauration, animations, services techniques).
- Développer l'accueil des séminaires : logistique, équipements adaptés, services sur mesure.
- Superviser les animations (programmes variés pour familles et adultes, semaines thématiques).
- Assurer la gestion des réclamations et proposer des solutions adaptées.
2. MANAGEMENT ET RESSOURCES HUMAINES
- Recruter, former et encadrer une équipe pluridisciplinaire
- Organiser les plannings en tenant compte des pics d'activité.
- Animer les réunions d'équipe et favoriser la coopération interservices.
- Gérer les conflits et maintenir un climat social positif.
- Évaluer les performances et mettre en place des plans de développement.
3. GESTION OPÉRATIONNELLE ET FINANCIÈRE
- Piloter le budget du village et rendre compte à la direction générale.
- Optimiser les coûts (achats groupés, gestion des stocks, maintenance préventive).
- Superviser la maintenance des infrastructures et veiller au respect des normes ERP, HACCP et sécurité.
- Assurer la passation entre saisons (clôtures comptables, inventaires).
- Développer des partenariats locaux.

VOTRE PROFIL
Formation et Expérience
- Bac+2 à Bac+5 en management hôtelier, tourisme, gestion d'entreprise ou équivalent.
- Expérience : Minimum 3 ans en tant que Directeur(trice), hôtel-club 3*+
- Expérience impérative dans la gestion de séminaires et groupes loisirs.
Compétences Techniques
- Gestion financière : Maîtrise des budgets, tableaux de bord, analyse de rentabilité.
- Outils informatiques : Suite Office, logiciels de gestion hôtelière, outils de réservation en ligne.
- Réglementaire : Connaissance du droit du travail, des conventions collectives, et des obligations légales.
- Capacité à assurer un reporting structuré, précis et constant.
Qualités Humaines
- Leadership et exemplarité : Capacité à fédérer et motiver des équipes en contexte saisonnier.
- Polyvalence et adaptabilité : Gestion simultanée de publics variés et d'imprévus.
- Sens du service client : Empathie, écoute, réactivité et justesse.
- Rigueur et organisation : Gestion des priorités et respect des délais.
- Résistance au stress : Capacité à gérer les pics d'activité.

Acteur du tourisme associatif depuis 1949, la marque Neaclub est née en 2018 de la fusion de deux associations du tourisme social et familial : Les Carrefours de l'Amitié et Chemins. Aujourd'hui, Neaclub gère 5 villages-club labellisés 3 étoiles Atout-France, ainsi qu'un chalet-refuge en Haute-Savoie, Savoie et en Drôme Provençale :
- Les Balcons du lac d'Annecy situé à Sevrier (74) ;
- Les Cîmes du Léman situé à Habère-Poche (74) ;
- La Pulka situé à Valloire (73) ;
- La Lauza situé à Valmeinier (73) ;
- Les Lavandes situé à Rémuzat (26) ;
- Le Chalet-refuge
